lines.japanese:
「あ、テストと言えば、こないだ大あわてで勉強し
　てた数学の小テスト……結局まだ採点終わってな
　くて、そのまま返ってきた」
lines.english: “Oh, speaking of tests, that math quiz I was frantically cramming for the other day… They still hadn't finished grading it, so they just handed it back.”

lines.japanese: 「それは……」
lines.english: “That's…”

lines.japanese: 「隣の人と交換して採点しれって言われてさ」
lines.english: “They told us to swap with the person next to us and grade each other's papers.”

lines.japanese: 「あの学校アカンよね、そういうとこ」
lines.english: “Your school really is hopeless about that sort of thing.”

lines.japanese:
「脱力した。しかもそれ回収しないし。
　成績反映せんのかいと」
lines.english: “It took all the wind out of me. And then they didn't even collect the papers. I mean, does this count toward our grades or not?”

lines.japanese:
「でも教職員の人、今の時期は大変らしいよ。
　姉さんもそれで忙しそうだ」
lines.english: “Teachers are apparently swamped this time of year. Sis seems busy with it too.”

lines.japanese:
あずさは陽光に晒すよう視線を跳ね上げ、片手で
ひさしを作る。
lines.english: Azusa tipped her face up to the sunlight and raised one hand to shade her eyes.

lines.japanese:
ふちからはみ出た瞳をすがめた。
　そして結論づけるように軽い口調で、
lines.english: She squinted past the edge of her hand. Then she delivered her conclusion in a light tone—

lines.japanese: 「学級崩壊ってやつだね」
lines.english: “That’s what they call a classroom falling apart.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは」
lines.english: “Ha ha.”

lines.japanese: 「そうならないように、学校に行こうか」
lines.english: “Then let’s go to school and keep it from falling apart.”

lines.japanese:
今度は自ら、片手に力をこめた。
　掌中、華奢な五指がくしゃりと崩れる。
lines.english: This time Shinobu gave her hand a deliberate squeeze. Her five slender fingers crumpled in his grasp.
“…This—”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「いかんなぁ、あたし―――ごめん、忍くん」
lines.english: “I'm hopeless… Sorry, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
立ち止まる。
　片手で、顔を覆った。
lines.english: She stopped. Covered her face with one hand.

lines.japanese: 「どうしたって？　どこか……痛いの？」
lines.english: “What's wrong? Does something… hurt?”

lines.japanese: 「乙女心と秋の空ってところかしら」
lines.english: “A maiden's heart is as changeable as the autumn sky, I suppose.”

lines.japanese: 細い声がよく通った。
lines.english: The soft voice carried clearly.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、沙也加……」
lines.english: “Oh, Sayaka…”

lines.japanese: 少女は颯爽と歩いてきて、一行に加わる。
lines.english: The girl strode briskly over and joined them.

lines.japanese: 「今朝、目薬はさした？」
lines.english: “Did you use your eye drops this morning?”

lines.japanese: 「さしてない」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「ラジオで、今朝は乾燥するといっていたのよ」
lines.english: “The radio said the air would be dry this morning.”

lines.japanese: そんなものか、と忍は思う。
lines.english: So that was all it was, Shinobu thought.

lines.japanese: 「さっき、空見てた時だ」
lines.english: “It must've happened when you were looking at the sky earlier.”

lines.japanese: 「ごみん」
lines.english: “Eye'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「いいさ」
lines.english: “It's fine.”

lines.japanese: 「ゴミだけに」
lines.english: “Eye. Get it?”

lines.japanese: 「……左様か」
lines.english: “…Indeed.”

lines.japanese: 「忍、目薬は持っている？」
lines.english: “Shinobu, do you have eye drops?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、さすがに」
lines.english: “No. Not on me.”

lines.japanese: 「なら、じっとしていて」
lines.english: “Then hold still.”

lines.japanese:
沙也加は少し身をかがめて、
　あずさの瞳を舌先で舐めた。
lines.english: Sayaka bent slightly and licked Azusa's eye with the tip of her tongue.

lines.japanese: 「ぁひゃぅわ」
lines.english: “Ahhyaowah!”

lines.japanese: トクン、と心臓が波打ってしまう。
lines.english: His heart gave a single, involuntary thump.

lines.japanese: 「と、取れたよ、もう平気」
lines.english: “I-it's out. I'm fine now.”

lines.japanese: 慌てた様子で身を離す。
lines.english: Azusa pulled away, flustered.

lines.japanese: 「そう？」
lines.english: “Is that so?”

lines.japanese: 「うー、目がごろごろする」
lines.english: “Ugh, my eye still feels gritty.”

lines.japanese: 「こうやって取るものだけれど」
lines.english: “That's how you're supposed to get it out.”

lines.japanese:
「うまくやると、触れずに砂だけさらえるのよ？
　舌というものは意外と器用なものね」
lines.english: “If you do it right, you can sweep away the grit without touching the eye itself. The tongue is surprisingly dexterous.”

lines.japanese:
「……あなただけです、舌でサクランボの茎が結べ
　るのは」
lines.english: “…You're the only one who can tie a cherry stem with your tongue.”

lines.japanese: 「そう、だったの……そう」
lines.english: “Oh… is that so… I see.”

lines.japanese: 考え込んでしまった。
lines.english: She lapsed into thought.

lines.japanese:
「うー、あたしはコンタクトとかつけられない人な
　のです。おめめ弱いから」
lines.english: “Ugh. I'm one of those people who can't wear contacts. My eyes are too delicate.”

lines.japanese: 猫のように、舐められた目尻をこすっている。
lines.english: Like a cat, she rubbed at the corner of the eye Sayaka had licked.

lines.japanese: （イケナイ感が……膨れあがっていく……）
lines.english: (This is starting to feel more and more forbidden…)

lines.japanese:
横目に、忍はドキドキしていた。
　持ち上がった黒目が幽艶な光沢を宿し、忍の視線
を絡め取る。
lines.english: Shinobu watched sidelong, his heart pounding. Her dark iris, turned upward, gleamed with a bewitching light that caught and entangled his gaze.

lines.japanese: 叱られた子供の気持ちになってしまう。
lines.english: He felt like a child being scolded.

lines.japanese: 「忍も目にゴミが入ったかしら？」
lines.english: “Is there something in your eye too, Shinobu?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、その……」
lines.english: “No, I…”

lines.japanese:
入ってない、僕はいい……とそれだけで解決する
問題である。
lines.english: Nothing's in it. I'm fine— that was all he had to say, and the entire matter would be resolved.

lines.japanese: 即断できない忍だ。
lines.english: But Shinobu was no good at snap decisions.

lines.japanese: 「遠慮しないで。大丈夫だから」
lines.english: “Don't hold back. It'll be all right.”

lines.japanese: 珍しくにっこりと笑うと、
lines.english: She gave him one of her rare smiles—

lines.japanese: 「これでも舌、とても器用なの」
lines.english: “My tongue really is very dexterous.”

lines.japanese:
男をいろいろとダメにする台詞である。
　忍も例外ではなく。
lines.english: The sort of line that could ruin a man in any number of ways. Shinobu was no exception.

lines.japanese: 「いや……沙也、ちょっと」
lines.english: “No… Saya, wait.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あたしもやる」
lines.english: “O-oh, I'll do it too.”

lines.japanese: 「ならひとつずつわけましょうか」
lines.english: “Then shall we take one eye each?”

lines.japanese: 「うん！」
lines.english: “Yeah!”

lines.japanese: 壁に押さえつけられて、
lines.english: They pinned him against the wall.

lines.japanese: 「二人、とも？」
lines.english: “Both… of you?”

lines.japanese:
逃げるように膝が折れた。かえってやりやすくな
ってしまうことには気づかない。
lines.english: His knees buckled as he tried to retreat, without realizing that this only made things easier for them.

lines.japanese:
二つの顔が接近する。青く甘い匂い。
　沙也加の髪束が肩口を滑り落ち、忍の鼻先をやわ
く叩いた。
lines.english: Two faces drew close. A green, sweet scent. A lock of Sayaka's hair slipped over her shoulder and softly tapped the tip of Shinobu's nose.

lines.japanese:
咄嗟に顔を伏せようとすると、くいと顎先をつか
まれてしまう。沙也加の手。
lines.english: When he instinctively tried to duck away, fingers caught his chin and tipped it up. Sayaka's hand.

lines.japanese: 「おめめ、あけて」
lines.english: “Open your eyes.”

lines.japanese: 「あけて」
lines.english: “Open them.”

lines.japanese: 「き、きみたち……なんか……」
lines.english: “Y-you two… This is getting…”

lines.japanese:
悪ふざけのはずなのに、どこか迫力があって、忍
は逆らえない。
lines.english: It was only supposed to be horseplay, but there was something overpowering about them, and Shinobu couldn't resist.

lines.japanese:
開かれた両視界。
　微妙に色合いの違う薄紅色がそれぞれを満たし、
そして―――
lines.english: Both eyes lay open now. A subtly different shade of pale rose filled each field of vision, and then—

lines.japanese:
表面を愛撫された。
　無意識に忍は呻いた。
　何を口走ったのかも記憶にない。
lines.english: A caress passed over each surface. Shinobu moaned involuntarily. He could not remember what he had blurted out.

lines.japanese:
そうとうに情けなく、また頼りない声であったは
ずだ。
lines.english: It must have been a pathetic, helpless sound.

lines.japanese: （感覚がないのに、違和感だけが……）
lines.english: (I can't feel it, and yet something feels so wrong…)

lines.japanese:
どちらが沙也加でどちらがあずさか思い出せない。
　まぶたは開いているのに、何も見えない。
lines.english: He could no longer remember which was Sayaka and which was Azusa. His eyelids were open, yet he could see nothing.

lines.japanese:
左側の舌が、心得たように動く。本当にそれは、
微妙な圧力と繊細な感性。
lines.english: The tongue on the left moved with practiced assurance. Its pressure was subtle, its touch exquisitely sensitive.

lines.japanese: （撫でられ、る―――？）
lines.english: (I'm being… stroked—?)

lines.japanese:
体が強ばって動かない。
　心地よい悪戯が、接着剤となって体を固定する。
　ものを考えることができなくなる。
lines.english: His body went rigid and would not move. The pleasant mischief turned to glue, pinning him in place. He could no longer think.

lines.japanese:
右側の舌は少し乱暴だ。
　乱暴だが、無邪気で。
lines.english: The tongue on the right was a little rougher. Rough, but innocent.

lines.japanese:
とらえようのない焦燥を、瞳の奥に押し込もうと
しているような……どこかもの悲しくもある接触。
lines.english: It was a touch that seemed to be pressing some indefinable restlessness deep behind his eye… and yet there was something sad about it.

lines.japanese:
右の耳朶を、短い鼻息が打つ。
　忍にはそれで区別がついた。
lines.english: Short breaths brushed his right earlobe. That was enough for Shinobu to tell them apart.

lines.japanese: （おかしな……気分に……なる……）
lines.english: (This is making me feel… strange…)

lines.japanese:
官能が忍の思考力をほどいてしまう。
　何も考えられなくなる。
lines.english: Sensuality unraveled Shinobu's thoughts. He could no longer think at all.

lines.japanese: （セク……ハラ……だ）
lines.english: (This is… sexual… harassment.)

lines.japanese:
薄れゆく意識の片隅で、そう思う。
　ついに頭が白む。
lines.english: The thought lingered at the edge of his fading consciousness. At last, his mind went blank.

lines.japanese:
このまま続いたらもう他の部分がどうなってもわ
からないぞ！という状態である。
lines.english: If this kept up, he wouldn’t even know what was happening to the rest of his body!

lines.japanese: 忍を絶頂の窮地から救ったのは。
lines.english: What saved Shinobu at the climax of his predicament was—

lines.japanese: 「なに、してんの？」
lines.english: “What are you doing?”

lines.japanese: 滑舌の手本を思わせる、力強い笛子の言葉。
lines.english: Fueko's crisp, forceful delivery was a model of perfect diction.

lines.japanese: 連行されている。
lines.english: He was being marched away.

lines.japanese: 連行されているのは、忍だ。
lines.english: The one being marched away was Shinobu.

lines.japanese:
両サイドを固めているのは、遅れて合流してきた
笛子と葉子だ。
lines.english: Fueko and Youko, who had joined them late, flanked him on either side.

lines.japanese: それぞれ、しっかと腕を組まれている。
lines.english: Each had one of his arms firmly hooked in hers.

lines.japanese: 「どうして、こんなことになってるんだろう……」
lines.english: “How did things end up like this…?”

lines.japanese: 「独占禁止法により」
lines.english: “Antitrust law.”

lines.japanese: 「不本意かも……」
lines.english: “This isn't exactly what I had in mind…”

lines.japanese: 「男冥利に尽きる局面でしょ？」
lines.english: “Isn't this the sort of moment that makes being a man worthwhile?”

lines.japanese: 「つまらぬ」
lines.english: “Boring.”

lines.japanese:
あずさと沙也加は、二人で後方を歩かされている。
罰として。
lines.english: Azusa and Sayaka had been made to walk together behind the others. As punishment.

lines.japanese:
「往来でとんでもないことしてる子たちの言うこと
　は聞きません」
lines.english: “I don't listen to girls who pull outrageous stunts in the middle of the street.”

lines.japanese: 「隔離隔離」
lines.english: “Quarantine, quarantine.”

lines.japanese: 「こっちが隔離されるんだ……」
lines.english: “So I'm the one who gets quarantined…”

lines.japanese: 「忍も忍。昼間っから腰砕けになって」
lines.english: “And you, Shinobu. Weak at the knees in broad daylight.”

lines.japanese: 嘆息まじりに言われて、返す言葉もない。
lines.english: The sigh in her voice left him with no reply.

lines.japanese: 「……ごめん、二人とも」
lines.english: “…Sorry, you two.”

lines.japanese: 「これはこれで」
lines.english: “This arrangement has its merits.”

lines.japanese: 「そう言っていただけると」
lines.english: “It helps to hear you say that.”

lines.japanese:
正直、柔らかいものが両腕に当たる現状も、気に
なるところではあるのだが。
lines.english: Though, honestly, the soft things pressed against both his arms were hard not to notice.

lines.japanese: （笛子の方が……）
lines.english: (Fueko's are…)

lines.japanese:
考えるのをやめる。
　本当に朝っぱらから、どうかしていた。
　ふと、気づく。
lines.english: He cut that thought short. There really was something wrong with him this early in the morning. Then he noticed something.

lines.japanese: 「斎と章二はいないんだね」
lines.english: “Itsuki and Shouji aren't here.”

lines.japanese: 「兄は部活」
lines.english: “My brother has club practice.”

lines.japanese:
「章二なんて、三日にいっぺんも登校してない
　でしょ」
lines.english: “Shouji doesn't even come to school once every three days, does he?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ……サボりか」
lines.english: “Oh… Skipping, then.”

lines.japanese: よくあることである。
lines.english: It was nothing unusual.

lines.japanese: 「困ったね」
lines.english: “That's a problem.”

lines.japanese: 「本当」
lines.english: “It is.”

lines.japanese: 「仲間うちから落第者なんて出したくないものね」
lines.english: “I don't want anyone in our group flunking out.”

lines.japanese: 「今度会ったら言っておくよ」
lines.english: “I'll talk to him next time I see him.”

lines.japanese: 「そーしてちょーだい」
lines.english: “Do that, pleeease.”

lines.japanese: 「忍さんの言うことは、きく？」
lines.english: “Will he listen to you, Shinobu?”

lines.japanese: 「どうだろ？」
lines.english: “Who knows?”

lines.japanese: 樋口章二は独立独歩。
lines.english: Shouji Higuchi always went his own way.

lines.japanese: 「……自分勝手なんだって」
lines.english: “…You mean he's selfish.”

lines.japanese: 後頭部で両腕を組んで、あずさ。
lines.english: Azusa folded her arms behind her head.

lines.japanese: 「いーつも勝手に行動してまーす」
lines.english: “Always off doing whatever he waaants.”

lines.japanese: 「そうね、まあ……最初からそうだったし」
lines.english: “Yeah. Well… He was like that from the start.”

lines.japanese: 「良くない噂もいろいろとあるわね」
lines.english: “There are all kinds of unsavory rumors about him.”

lines.japanese: 「それはもうたくさんね」
lines.english: “Far too many.”

lines.japanese:
「うちの学校にも、あいつのこと知ってる人、いる
　みたいね。というか有名人だったようで」
lines.english: “Apparently people at my school know him too. Sounds like he was pretty famous.”

lines.japanese: 「笛っちの学校にも手出してたんだ……」
lines.english: “He was making moves at your school too…”

lines.japanese: 「広く浅く、と言っていたわね。確か」
lines.english: “‘Broad and shallow,’ I believe he called it.”

lines.japanese: 「なんてこと。一夫多妻じゃない」
lines.english: “Honestly. That’s polygamy.”

lines.japanese:
「……お笛さん、そこ攻撃するとこのグループも危
　うい」
lines.english: “…Fueko, if you go after him for that, this group is in danger too.”

lines.japanese:
耳打ちした葉子だが、しっかり忍にも聞こえてし
まった。
lines.english: Youko whispered it, but Shinobu heard every word.

lines.japanese:
それでも自分のことを指しているのかどうか確証
が持てず、人知れずドキドキしていた。
lines.english: Even then, he couldn’t be sure she meant him. His heart raced, unnoticed by the others.

lines.japanese: 「う……そうだけど……」
lines.english: “Urgh… That's true, but…”

lines.japanese: 「我々のは……その……誠意のある……」
lines.english: “Ours is… well… sincere…”

lines.japanese: 「ある？」
lines.english: “Is it?”

lines.japanese: 「……あー、言えません」
lines.english: “…Oh, never mind. I can't claim that.”

lines.japanese: 「賢明ね」
lines.english: “Wise.”

lines.japanese: 会話が飛んだ気がして、忍は首をかしげた。
lines.english: Shinobu tilted his head, feeling as though he'd missed a step in the conversation.

lines.japanese: 「あのさ、笛」
lines.english: “Hey, Fueko.”

lines.japanese: 「なに？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese:
「章二が自分で言ってたんだけど……
　飽きっぽいんだってさ」
lines.english: “Shouji said this himself… He gets bored easily.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese:
「それで拘束されるの嫌いだから、本気の恋とかで
　きないんだって」
lines.english: “And he hates feeling tied down, so he says he can't ever really fall in love.”

lines.japanese: 「なんてこと」
lines.english: “Unbelievable.”

lines.japanese: 笛子は呆れた。
lines.english: Fueko was appalled.

lines.japanese:
「だから一生つきあうかも知れない相手とは、そう
　いう関係にならないようにしてるんだって」
lines.english: “So he makes a point of never getting involved that way with anyone who might be in his life for good.”

lines.japanese: 「君たちのことだよね」
lines.english: “That means you two, doesn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「あたしらには、しなかった話だね」
lines.english: “He never told the rest of us that.”

lines.japanese: 「忍にはそういうことまで話すのね。驚いた」
lines.english: “He tells you about that sort of thing? I'm surprised.”

lines.japanese: 言いつつ、表情に乱れのない沙也加だ。
lines.english: Sayaka said it without a flicker of expression.

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Oh.”

lines.japanese:
「章二にとっては、あれが一番安心できる状態なん
　だよ」
lines.english: “For Shouji, that's when he feels safest.”

lines.japanese:
「よく遊んだけど……女の子とどこか行くときも、
　自分から愛想良く話しかけたりはしてなかったよ。
　それでもてるんだから凄いけど」
lines.english: “We hung out a lot… Even when we went out with girls, he never struck up a friendly conversation himself. Still, they liked him. Pretty impressive.”

lines.japanese: 「不良っぽいからかしら……まったくもう」
lines.english: “Maybe it was the bad-boy thing… Honestly.”

lines.japanese: 法と混沌はいつでも対立するのである。
lines.english: Law and chaos were forever opposed.

lines.japanese: 「斎くんはそーいう話きかないね」
lines.english: “You never hear stuff like that about Itsuki.”

lines.japanese: 「年上スキーです」
lines.english: “He has a thing for older women.”

lines.japanese: 実妹の言葉に、
lines.english: At those words from his own younger sister—

lines.japanese:
沙也加はうつむいて口元を押さえ、小さく肩を震
わせた。
lines.english: Sayaka ducked her head and covered her mouth, her shoulders quivering slightly.

lines.japanese: 「ありそう……」
lines.english: “I can believe it…”

lines.japanese:
「蔵書の一部が示す傾向は、間違いなくその事実を
　浮き彫りにしているのです」
lines.english: “The pattern evident in part of his library throws that fact into unmistakable relief.”

lines.japanese:
「……と、蔵書交換などを活発にしている忍さん、
　そうですよね？」
lines.english: “And you would know, Shinobu, given how often the two of you trade books. Am I right?”

lines.japanese: 「ごほんげほん」

lines.japanese: 「なぜだと思いますか？」
lines.english: “Why do you think?”

lines.japanese: 「わからないよ、葉子」
lines.english: “I don't know, Youko.”

lines.japanese: 「からだが、柔らかくなるんですよ？」
lines.english: “My body is going to get soft, you know?”

lines.japanese: 「わからない、わからないよ！」
lines.english: “I don't know! I don't get it!”

lines.japanese: 「ふわっと、するんです」
lines.english: “It will get all soft and fluffy.”

lines.japanese: 「それはいいことだと思うけれど！」
lines.english: “I think that would be a good thing!”

lines.japanese: 「ふんわりボデーに無限の可能性が―――」
lines.english: “A soft, fluffy body holds infinite possibilities—”

lines.japanese:
「コント番組だったら今頃チャンネル変えてるとこ
　ろだ」
lines.english: “If this were a sketch show, I'd have changed the channel by now.”

lines.japanese: 冷水。
lines.english: A bucket of cold water.

lines.japanese: 「どうも、ペースに巻き込まれると……」
lines.english: “Once I get caught up in her rhythm…”

lines.japanese: 「そんな中和剤のようなところが好き」
lines.english: “I like how you act as a sort of neutralizing agent.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、そんなとこが？」
lines.english: “What? That's what you like?”

lines.japanese:
ようやく呼吸の整った葉子。
　一同に向き直って、
lines.english: At last Youko caught her breath. She turned back to the others.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさい……待ちましたか」
lines.english: “I'm sorry… Did you wait long?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、適当にだべってたから」
lines.english: “No, we were just chatting.”

lines.japanese: 「……ご機嫌いかが紅緒さん？」
lines.english: “…And how is Miss Benio?”

lines.japanese: 首だけをかしげた。
lines.english: She tilted her head. Only her head.

lines.japanese: 「笛子とこっちに来てるトコ」
lines.english: “She and Fueko are on their way.”

lines.japanese: 「とこ」
lines.english: “On their way.”

lines.japanese:
思うところがあったのか、トコトコ歩き出した。
　この段階になったら、あまり声は掛けない方がいい。
lines.english: Perhaps something had occurred to her; she pattered off. Once she got like this, it was best not to call after her.

lines.japanese: 「制服だとあまり無茶できないね」
lines.english: “We can't get too reckless in our uniforms.”

lines.japanese: 「ちびっ子もいるし、安全コースだな」
lines.english: “We've got the little ones along too. Safe route it is.”

lines.japanese: 「だね」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 「ハーイ、みんな！」
lines.english: “Hi, everyone!”

lines.japanese: 「やほー」
lines.english: “Heya.”

lines.japanese: ほどなく、全員集合。
lines.english: Before long, the whole group had assembled.

lines.japanese: 「久しぶりに重役合流ね」
lines.english: “I get to make a late VIP entrance for once.”

lines.japanese: 「タクシーチケットべんりー」
lines.english: “Taxi vouchers are so convenient.”

lines.japanese: 「いくらでも手に入る」
lines.english: “I can get as many as I want.”

lines.japanese: 「すごい……忍君」
lines.english: “Amazing… Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
あずさが両手に抱えた黄色いチケットの束から、
章二が一枚を抜き出す。
lines.english: From the bundle of yellow vouchers Azusa cradled in both arms, Shouji plucked one.

lines.japanese: 「これ、金券ショップで金にできるぞ」
lines.english: “You could turn these into cash at a voucher shop.”

lines.japanese: 「足がつくからダメ」
lines.english: “No. They'd trace them back to me.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなもんか」
lines.english: “That's how it works, huh?”

lines.japanese: 「うち、だからね」
lines.english: “They're issued to my family, remember.”

lines.japanese:
「一応、僕も病人ってことになってる。
　通院してるしね」
lines.english: “Officially, I count as a patient too. I go in for treatment, after all.”

lines.japanese: 「……で、コレか」
lines.english: “…So that's what these are for.”

lines.japanese: チケットを返す。
lines.english: He handed the voucher back.

lines.japanese:
「使用したら運ちゃんのサインつけてさ、提出しな
　きゃならない」
lines.english: “After you use one, you have to get the driver's signature and submit it.”

lines.japanese:
「本当は人に渡したらいけないんだけど……
　換金以外のことには甘くて」
lines.english: “Technically, I'm not supposed to give them to anyone else… but they turn a blind eye as long as you don't cash them in.”

lines.japanese: 「……もったいない話だ」
lines.english: “…What a waste.”

lines.japanese: 「かわりにグミやる」
lines.english: “I'll give you gummies instead.”

lines.japanese: 「いらん！」
lines.english: “Don't want 'em!”

lines.japanese: 「悪いわね、駅前まで来てもらって」
lines.english: “Sorry we made you come all the way to the station.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ今日はこのあたりでな」
lines.english: “We're sticking around here today anyway.”

lines.japanese: 「家に戻ってたの？」
lines.english: “Did you go home first?”

lines.japanese: 「ん。くつろいでた」
lines.english: “Mm. I was relaxing.”

lines.japanese: 「……お家あがって、でかいテレビ見てた」
lines.english: “…We went to her house and watched the huge TV.”

lines.japanese: 忍はあずさの頭を撫でた。
lines.english: Shinobu patted Azusa on the head.

lines.japanese: 「今はけっこうのんびりできる時期ですか」
lines.english: “Are things fairly quiet for you right now?”

lines.japanese:
「……ん、まあ……
　すぐに慌ただしくなりそうだけど」
lines.english: “…Mm, more or less… It'll probably get hectic again soon.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ……大変だね、進学校」
lines.english: “Oh… College-prep schools sound rough.”

lines.japanese:
「仕方ないわよ。正直、皆と同じ学校行ってれば良
　かったって思うけど……」
lines.english: “It can’t be helped. Honestly, I wish I’d gone to the same school as everyone else…”

lines.japanese: 自嘲する。
lines.english: Her tone was self-mocking.

lines.japanese:
「現実と戦う力、身につけられる学校に行きたかっ
　たから」
lines.english: “I wanted to go to a school where I'd learn the strength to fight reality.”

lines.japanese: 「武器とか装備するとか」
lines.english: “Like equipping weapons and armor.”

lines.japanese: 「……比喩で言ったのよ」
lines.english: “…It was a metaphor.”

lines.japanese:
「最初、迎えに笛っちの学校、ひさしぶりに行った
　らさ」
lines.english: “First I went to Fueko's school to pick her up. Hadn't been there in ages.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あんた……学校まで行ったの？」
lines.english: “Y-you… went all the way to the school?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。運ちゃん喜んでた」
lines.english: “Yep. The driver was happy.”

lines.japanese: 「稼ぎ時だって思ったんでしょうね」
lines.english: “He must have thought it was his chance to make some money.”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese:
「チケットの請求先は国だからさ、取りっぱぐれが
　ない」
lines.english: “The government picks up the tab, so there's no risk of getting stiffed.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう……それは良いことですな」
lines.english: “Ah… A fine thing indeed.”

lines.japanese: さほど理解していないに違いない。
lines.english: She could hardly have understood much of it.

lines.japanese: 「ねえあずさ。あんたその……学校に……入った？」
lines.english: “Azusa, did you… go inside the school?”

lines.japanese:
「んーん。入ってない。入れない。で、帰り際に誰
　かに声かけようとしたんだけど……あたし笛子ちゃ
　んのクラスとか知らなくて……」
lines.english: “Nope. I didn’t. I couldn’t. On my way back, I tried to ask somebody, but I didn’t know which class you were in…”

lines.japanese:
「で、十分くらい迷って、結局引き返して家に行っ
　たんだよ」
lines.english: “So I spent about ten minutes trying to decide what to do, then gave up and went to your house.”

lines.japanese: 「……まったく」
lines.english: “…Honestly.”

lines.japanese: 疲れたように肩を落とす。
lines.english: Her shoulders sagged wearily.

lines.japanese: 「……どうしたの」
lines.english: “…What's wrong?”

lines.japanese:
「ええと……うちの学校、今ちょっとぴりぴりして
　るから……その……」
lines.english: “Um… Things are a little tense at our school right now… so…”

lines.japanese: 「進学校は大変ですね」
lines.english: “College-prep schools have it rough.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、こわかったよ、こわかった」
lines.english: “Yeah, it was scary. Scary.”

lines.japanese: 「こわい？」
lines.english: “Scary?”

lines.japanese: 「……こわかったよ。全員眼鏡してたし」
lines.english: “…It was scary. Everybody wore glasses.”

lines.japanese: 「そこ、無茶苦茶な嘘つかない！」
lines.english: “Don't make up ridiculous stuff like that!”

lines.japanese: 「ほんとうだよ！」
lines.english: “It's true!”

lines.japanese:
「いい……卒業したらコンタクトにする……そんで
　目からレーザー出してあずさを攻撃する……」
lines.english: “Fine… Once I graduate, I'll get contacts… Then I'll shoot lasers out of my eyes at you…”

lines.japanese: 「なぜあたしが！？」
lines.english: “Why me!?”

lines.japanese: 笛子があずさの両の頬をつまむ。
lines.english: Fueko pinched both of Azusa's cheeks.

lines.japanese: 「可愛いあんたを……一番にっ」
lines.english: “You're so cute… You'll be my first target!”

lines.japanese: 「やめれぇ～」
lines.english: “Staaahp!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、まるで、おもちのようなこの感触……」
lines.english: “Oh, this texture… It's just like mochi…”

lines.japanese: 「もちちがう～っ」
lines.english: “Not mochi!”

lines.japanese:
「ね、ここから笛子の学校まで、いくらかかると
　思う？」
lines.english: “How much do you think it costs to take a taxi from here to Fueko's school?”

lines.japanese: 「……駅前からなら３千円くらいか？」
lines.english: “…From the station? About three thousand yen?”

lines.japanese: 「そんなかかるんだ？」
lines.english: “That much?”

lines.japanese: 「道が入り組んでるしな」
lines.english: “The roads twist all over the place.”

lines.japanese: 「往復６千円」
lines.english: “Six thousand round trip.”

lines.japanese: 「しばらく待たせてたと言っていたわね」
lines.english: “She said she kept him waiting for a while.”

lines.japanese: 「メーター稼働中だよね」
lines.english: “With the meter running.”

lines.japanese: 「稼ぎ時ですから」
lines.english: “It was his chance to make money.”

lines.japanese:
「で、笛子の家までちんたら走って……
　軽くツェーマンってところか？」
lines.english: “Then he crawled all the way to Fueko's house… That's an easy ten grand, isn't it?”

lines.japanese:
「……いや、チケットだからいいんだけど……
　大物だよね」
lines.english: “…Well, she had vouchers, so it's fine… Still, that girl's something else.”

lines.japanese:
「あいつ、タクシーの仕組み知らないんじゃねぇの
　か？」
lines.english: “She doesn't know how taxis work, does she?”

lines.japanese: 「まあいいじゃない」
lines.english: “It's all right.”

lines.japanese:
「……チケットない時に軽い気持ちで知らずに乗っ
　てドボン」
lines.english: “…If she hops in without vouchers, not knowing any better, she’ll be sunk.”

lines.japanese: 「こわい。ありそうでこわい」
lines.english: “Terrifying. And terrifyingly plausible.”

lines.japanese: 「額自体は平気なのか？」
lines.english: “Are they okay with that kind of bill?”

lines.japanese: 忍は考え込む。
lines.english: Shinobu thought it over.

lines.japanese: 「……まさか文句は言ってこないとは思うけど……」
lines.english: “…I can't imagine they'd complain, but…”

lines.japanese: 少し不安になった。
lines.english: He grew slightly uneasy.

lines.japanese: 「……あー、買っちゃった……やっちゃった」
lines.english: “…Oh, no. I bought it… I've really done it.”

lines.japanese: 「派手に買ったものね」
lines.english: “You certainly went to town.”

lines.japanese: 「ストレスがたまってるのかしら……」
lines.english: “Maybe the stress is getting to me…”

lines.japanese: 「てるの？」
lines.english: “Is it?”

lines.japanese: 「……最近テストばっかりだったから……つい」
lines.english: “…We've had nothing but tests lately… I couldn't help myself.”

lines.japanese: 「財布が軽い……」
lines.english: “My wallet is so light…”

lines.japanese: 「買って後悔するタイプ」
lines.english: “The kind who buys first and regrets it later.”
“Urgh…”

lines.japanese: 「そーいや久しぶりだね、みんなでお店冷やかすの」
lines.english: “Come to think of it, it's been ages since we all went window-shopping.”

lines.japanese: 「たまにはいいわね」
lines.english: “It's nice once in a while.”

lines.japanese: 「財布が……」
lines.english: “My wallet…”

lines.japanese: 「ストレス発散になったんだし、いいじゃない」
lines.english: “You worked off some stress, so it's fine.”

lines.japanese: 「そうね」
lines.english: “You're right.”

lines.japanese: 「そして新たなストレスも誕生」
lines.english: “And with it, a whole new source of stress.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、うー」
lines.english: “Aah, ugh.”
“…That's rough.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、そーいえばショージは？」
lines.english: “Hey, where's Shouji, anyway?”

lines.japanese: 「買い物があるって。待ち合わせ場所はファミレス」
lines.english: “He had some shopping to do. We're meeting at the family restaurant.”

lines.japanese: 「みんなで一緒にいる時に買えば良かったのに」
lines.english: “Why didn't he shop while we were all together?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、それはきついかな……」
lines.english: “No, that might have been awkward…”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 友情の沈黙。
lines.english: The silence of friendship.

lines.japanese: 「友情の沈黙」
lines.english: “The silence of friendship.”

lines.japanese: 「ごほっげほっ」
lines.english: “Ahem—cough.”

lines.japanese: 「……あー、わかった。なんかえちぃのだ」
lines.english: “…Oh, I get it. Something naughty.”

lines.japanese: 場の空気が十度も下がった気がした。
lines.english: The temperature seemed to drop ten degrees.

lines.japanese: 「なるほどね」
lines.english: “Now I get it.”

lines.japanese: 「性欲の権化」
lines.english: “The embodiment of lust.”

lines.japanese: 「さもありなん」
lines.english: “As one might expect.”

lines.japanese: 「君たち」
lines.english: “You people.”

lines.japanese: 友情の男が往く。
lines.english: On went the loyal friend.

lines.japanese:
「かばうことないよ、もうネタは割れてるんだよ。
　えてぃ本でしょ？」
lines.english: “No need to defend him. We've already cracked the case. Naughty books, right?”

lines.japanese:
「違うみたいです。本ではなく、もっと実用的な生々
　しいアイテムではないかと思われます」
lines.english: “Apparently not. I suspect something more practical—and much more intimate— than a book.”

lines.japanese: 「心読んだの？」
lines.english: “Did you read my mind?”

lines.japanese: 「じゃなんだろね」
lines.english: “What could it be, then?”

lines.japanese: 「……章二、うちの学校だと評判悪いんだ」
lines.english: “…Shouji has a pretty bad reputation at my school.”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese:
「前にうちの女の子とつきあってたらしいんだけど、
　二股かけられてしかも振られたとか」
lines.english: “Apparently he used to date a girl from my school, and he two-timed her, then dumped her.”

lines.japanese: 「悪魔だ……」
lines.english: “He's a demon…”

lines.japanese: 「さもありなん」
lines.english: “As one might expect.”

lines.japanese: 「忍くんはそんなことしないよね？」
lines.english: “You'd never do that, would you, Shinobu?”

lines.japanese: 「ええと、しないと思うけど……」
lines.english: “Um, I don't think I would…”

lines.japanese: なぜか声が尻すぼみになる。
lines.english: For some reason, his voice trailed off.

lines.japanese:
「噂が広がっててね。このあたりじゃ一番有名な女
　たらしだと思う」
lines.english: “The story got around. I think he's the most notorious womanizer in this entire area.”
“Ah…”

lines.japanese:
「うちは神経質な校風だからね。そういうのは否定
　的というか」
lines.english: “My school's pretty uptight. People there don't exactly approve of that sort of thing.”

lines.japanese:
「でもずいぶん丸くなったんだよ、あれでも。
　暴力振るうこともなくなったし」
lines.english: “But he's mellowed out a lot, believe it or not. He doesn't hit people anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「このあいだケンカしてましたが」
lines.english: “He got into a fight the other day.”

lines.japanese: 忍はあさっての方向を見た。
lines.english: Shinobu looked pointedly off in another direction.

lines.japanese: （どうしようもない）
lines.english: (He's hopeless.)

lines.japanese:
樋口章二。
　その破天荒な生き様は、友のフォローさえ埒外に
置いてしまうのである。
lines.english: Shouji Higuchi. His wild way of life was too much even for a friend to defend.

lines.japanese: そして一行はファミレスに入った。
lines.english: And so the group entered the family restaurant.

lines.japanese: 「ま、安全コースよね」
lines.english: “Well, it is the safe option.”

lines.japanese: 「食べ物もいくらでも出てくる」
lines.english: “And you can get as much food as you want.”

lines.japanese: すでに忍はメニューを食い入るように見ている。
lines.english: Shinobu was already devouring the menu with his eyes.

lines.japanese: 「そんなの見てたら食べたくなっちゃうなー」
lines.english: “Looking at that is making me hungry.”

lines.japanese: 「いいんじゃない、食べたら？」
lines.english: “Why don't you eat, then?”

lines.japanese: 「フリードリンクだけでいー……いーのだー……」
lines.english: “I'll just have the drink bar… That's all I neeed…”

lines.japanese:
「……おまえら、こいつがちびっ子だって忘れてる
　だろ」
lines.english: “…You guys are forgetting she's still a kid, aren't you?”

lines.japanese:
しょんぼりとしたあずさの頭に、章二が肘を置い
て体重をかけた。
lines.english: Shouji planted an elbow on the dejected Azusa's head and leaned his weight onto it.

lines.japanese: 「ぐあ」
lines.english: “Gah.”

lines.japanese: 「はやかったね」
lines.english: “That was fast.”

lines.japanese: メニューから目線を移動させず、忍。
lines.english: Shinobu did not lift his eyes from the menu.

lines.japanese: 「ああ」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「くび、くびが……っ」
lines.english: “My neck… my neck is…”

lines.japanese: 「葉子は？」
lines.english: “Where's Youko?”

lines.japanese:
「さっき、いつも月に一週間くらいしか持参してこ
　ない謎のポーチを持ってトイレに行ったよ」
lines.english: “She took that mysterious pouch she carries for only a week or so every month and went to the restroom.”

lines.japanese: 「セヤっ」
lines.english: “Hya!”

lines.japanese: 笛子地獄突き。
lines.english: Fueko's hell thrust.

lines.japanese: 「ぐあっ」
lines.english: “Gah!”
“…That… really hurt… Fueko…”

lines.japanese: 「……乙女心をわかってやれ……頼むから」
lines.english: “…Try to understand a maiden's heart… Please.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、なにが？」
lines.english: “Sure. What, exactly?”

lines.japanese: 「だーかーらー……」
lines.english: “Like I said…”

lines.japanese:
笛子は恥じ入った。
　それ以上何を言っても、墓穴を掘ることになる。
lines.english: Fueko shrank in embarrassment. Anything else she said would only dig her own grave.

lines.japanese: 「乙女心ってなに？　なんの話？」
lines.english: “What's a maiden's heart? What are we talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、もういいデス……」
lines.english: “Never mind. Forget it…”

lines.japanese: 「天然最強説を……提唱するものである……」
lines.english: “I hereby propose… that obliviousness is the ultimate weapon…”

lines.japanese: 「なんかひどいこと言われてる」
lines.english: “I feel like someone just said something awful about me.”

lines.japanese: 「つまり葉子は生理か」
lines.english: “So Youko is on her period.”

lines.japanese: 「セセヤっ」
lines.english: “H-hya!”

lines.japanese: 再度。
lines.english: Again.

lines.japanese: 「ぐおおっ」
lines.english: “Guaagh!”

lines.japanese:
それはクリティカルヒットであり、一歩間違えば
章二の喉仏を破壊しかねない一撃となった。
lines.english: It was a critical hit. One wrong move, and that blow could have crushed Shouji’s Adam’s apple.

lines.japanese: 「殺す気か！」
lines.english: “Are you trying to kill me!?”

lines.japanese:
