lines.japanese: 「こんなかんたんに……ひみつ基地まで」
lines.english: “Or that we'd get a secret base this easy…”

lines.japanese: あずさは膝を抱えた。
lines.english: Azusa hugged her knees.

lines.japanese: 「しんじらんない」
lines.english: “I can't believe it.”

lines.japanese: 「だけど事実だ」
lines.english: “But it is a fact.”

lines.japanese: 「ジジツ？」
lines.english: “A fact?”

lines.japanese: 「本当のことだ」
lines.english: “Something that's true.”
“Oh…”

lines.japanese: 「確かに、友達がたくさんできた」
lines.english: “We really did make a lot of friends.”

lines.japanese: 「予想外にうまくいった」
lines.english: “It went unexpectedly well.”

lines.japanese: 「ヨソウガイ？」
lines.english: “Unexpectedly?”

lines.japanese: 「……しんじられないくらいうまくいったってこと」
lines.english: “…It means it worked so well I can hardly believe it.”
“Oh…”

lines.japanese: 「これって、すごいことだ」
lines.english: “This is really amazing.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなる」
lines.english: “It would seem so.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、だれがいちばん好き？」
lines.english: “Hey, who do you like best?”
“What…?”

lines.japanese: 「このメンバーで、一番いいのって誰？」
lines.english: “Out of everybody here, who's the best?”

lines.japanese: 「一番いいのって……基準は？」
lines.english: “The best… by what criterion?”

lines.japanese: 「キジュン？」
lines.english: “Criterion?”

lines.japanese:
「ん、つまり……強さってことか？
　それとも、頭の良さってこと？」
lines.english: “You mean… the strongest? Or the smartest?”

lines.japanese: 「うがちー」
lines.english: “Wrong-o!”

lines.japanese: 「うがち？」
lines.english: “Wrong-o?”

lines.japanese: 「ちがうってこと」
lines.english: “It means you're wrong.”
“Mm…”

lines.japanese: 「あははははははは！」
lines.english: “Ahahahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「……おこった？」
lines.english: “…Are you mad?”

lines.japanese: 「いいや」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese:
「ごめん……うけるかなーと思ったんだけど……
　ごめんなさい……」
lines.english: “Sorry… I thought it might make you laugh… I'm sorry…”

lines.japanese: 「いや？」
lines.english: “No?”

lines.japanese: 「うく、忍くんジョーダン通じないなぁ……」
lines.english: “Urk… You really don't get jokes, Shinobu…”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんよ」
lines.english: “Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「……はぁぁぁぁ」
lines.english: “…Haaaah.”

lines.japanese: 「どうしたの？」
lines.english: “What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「……ん、なんでもないよ」
lines.english: “…Nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「とりあえず、あたしは一番じゃないんだよね……」
lines.english: “So I'm not number one, then…”

lines.japanese: 「意味がわからないんだけど？」
lines.english: “I don't understand what you mean.”

lines.japanese:
「だーかーらー！　いっしょにいても笑わないって
　つまらないってことじゃないのかよー！」
lines.english: “I'm saaaying—if you don't laugh when you're with me, doesn't that mean you think I'm boring?!”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと待った。話が飛んでる」
lines.english: “Wait. That doesn't follow.”

lines.japanese: 「どういう見方で一番を決めるんだって？」
lines.english: “What are we supposed to be ranking them by?”

lines.japanese:
「え、そりゃだから……強さとか頭の良さとかじゃ
　なくて“好きさ”だよ」
lines.english: “Well… not by who's strongest or smartest, but by how much you like them.”

lines.japanese: 「どのくらい好きかってことか」
lines.english: “So you mean how much I like them.”
“Well?”

lines.japanese:
「どうと言われても……わからないよ。まだ知り合
　ったばかりだし」
lines.english: “I don't know what to tell you… I only just met everyone.”

lines.japanese: 「第一インショーってのがあるでしょ？」
lines.english: “But there's such a thing as a first impression, right?”

lines.japanese: 「そういう言葉は知ってるんだな」
lines.english: “So you know that phrase.”

lines.japanese: 「ピピピ」
lines.english: “Beep beep beep.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだって？」
lines.english: “What was that?”

lines.japanese: 「ピピピで決めたらって言ってもいいね」
lines.english: “You could use the beep-beep-beep to decide.”

lines.japanese: 「通信の音かな」
lines.english: “Is that the sound of a transmission?”

lines.japanese: 「心のね！」
lines.english: “From your heart!”

lines.japanese: 「……心の通信、か」
lines.english: “…A transmission from the heart.”

lines.japanese: 「さあ、誰？」
lines.english: “Come on, who?”

lines.japanese:
「うーん、考えたことがない……だけど、
　興味深いものの見方だね」
lines.english: “Hmm. I've never considered it… But that's an interesting way to look at things.”

lines.japanese: 「さて、どうだろう……好き、好きか……難しいな」
lines.english: “Let's see… Like… How much I like them… This is hard.”

lines.japanese: 「だけど、案外それが近道なのかも知れないな」
lines.english: “But maybe that's the shortcut after all.”

lines.japanese: 「近道って？」
lines.english: “Shortcut to what?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、独り言だよ」
lines.english: “No, just talking to myself.”
“……” (stare)
“…What?”

lines.japanese: 「忍くん、前よりよく話してくれるようになった」
lines.english: “You talk to me a lot more than you used to.”

lines.japanese: 「それはね」
lines.english: “That's because…”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese:
「あずさは、僕の一部みたいなものだから、必死に
　隠し事をする必要はないんだ」
lines.english: “You’re like a part of me, Azusa. So I don’t have to try so hard to hide things from you.”

lines.japanese: 「あずさ？」
lines.english: “Azusa?”

lines.japanese: 「鼻血が出てきた」
lines.english: “You've got a nosebleed.”
“Whaaaaaaaaaat?!”

lines.japanese: 「上は向かない方がいい」
lines.english: “Don't tilt your head back.”

lines.japanese: 「れ、れもっ！」
lines.english: “B-buh!”

lines.japanese: 「鼻をつまんで。そう。じっとして」
lines.english: “Pinch your nose. Yes. Hold still.”

lines.japanese:
「……あの、首筋は叩かなくていいから。
　むしろ叩かない方がいい」
lines.english: “…You don't need to hit the back of your neck. In fact, it's better not to.”
“Buh…”

lines.japanese:
「誰に教わったんだか。じっとして押さえていれば
　出血は止まる。安静に」
lines.english: “Who taught you that? Keep pinching it and the bleeding will stop. Don't move.”

lines.japanese: 「ほら、ティッシュ。これを」
lines.english: “Here. A tissue. Use this.”

lines.japanese: 「ふがー……」
lines.english: “Fngh…”

lines.japanese:
「……興奮によるものかな。さっき怒った時だね、
　きっと」
lines.english: “…Maybe it's from the excitement. From when you got mad earlier, probably.”

lines.japanese: 「今度は涙」
lines.english: “And now tears.”

lines.japanese: 「らって」
lines.english: “B-because…”
“…Snf…”

lines.japanese: 「……弱ったな」
lines.english: “…This is a problem.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、さっきの話だけど」
lines.english: “About what we were talking about…”

lines.japanese: 「“好きさ”の話だよ」
lines.english: “The question of ‘how much you like someone.’”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん」
lines.english: “Y-yeah.”

lines.japanese:
「正直わからない。
　みんなのことを、まだよく知らないから」
lines.english: “I honestly don't know. I don't know everyone very well yet.”
“But…”

lines.japanese: 「嫌いな人間は一人もいない」
lines.english: “There isn't a single person I dislike.”
“……I see.”
“And……”

lines.japanese: 「にゃに？」
lines.english: “Wha?”

lines.japanese: 「……中でもあずさは、特別な存在だよ」
lines.english: “…Out of everyone, you're someone special to me.”

lines.japanese: 「あずさ！」
lines.english: “Azusa!”

lines.japanese: 「ティッシュの栓が吹き飛んだ！？」
lines.english: “The tissue plug shot out?!”
“U-uh-oh…”

lines.japanese: 「すごい鼻血だ」
lines.english: “That's a tremendous nosebleed.”
“I-I'm dying! I'm gonna diiiiiie!”

lines.japanese: 「おかーーーーさーーーーーーーーーーーーん！！」
lines.english: “Mooooooooooom!!”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、落ち着いて！！」
lines.english: “H-hey, calm down!”

lines.japanese:
「ぎゃわーーーーーーーーーーー
　ーーーーーーーーーんっ！！」
lines.english: “Waaaaaaaaaaaaaa aaaaaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese:
工場には皆が集まる。
　最初は義務。
　幾人かは何も知らず。
lines.english: Everyone would gather at the factory. At first, it was an obligation. Some of them knew nothing.

lines.japanese:
幾人かは忍との約定によって言われるがままに。
　いつしか、当然のことになった。
lines.english: Some merely did as they were told, bound by an agreement with Shinobu. Before long, it became the natural thing to do.

lines.japanese:
関係がいつから変質したのか、線引きすることは
難しい。
lines.english: It's hard to draw a line and say when their relationship changed.

lines.japanese:
特定の時間を過ぎて、唐突にそうなったのか。
　あるいは細かな変化が蓄積されて、そうなったのか。
lines.english: Did it happen all at once, at some particular point in time? Or did it emerge from the accumulation of small changes?

lines.japanese:
どのような手順と過程を経て変質したのか。
　誰にもわからない。
lines.english: What steps, what process, had brought about the change? No one knows.

lines.japanese:
最高の知性と手段を振りかざし、各人の脳内の動
きまでも細密に分析すれば、数理上の判別をくだす
ことはできるだろう。
lines.english: Bring the finest intellect and methods to bear; analyze even the minute workings of every brain, and you could probably draw a mathematical distinction.

lines.japanese:
だが手間暇をかけて明らかにされる心の真実は、
決して優しくはないはず。
lines.english: But the truth of the heart laid bare at such cost would surely be anything but kind.

lines.japanese:
誰も望まない。
　実行しない。
lines.english: No one wants that. No one does it.

lines.japanese:
心はいつの間にか変化した、という浅見に甘んじ
ることを、時に人は厭わない。
lines.english: At times, people are content to accept the facile notion that the heart simply changed somewhere along the way.

lines.japanese:
魂とはそれほどまでに、価値を付与されたもので
ある。
lines.english: Such is the value we place upon the soul.

lines.japanese:
心は数値ではない。
　心は決して計れない。
lines.english: The heart is not a number. The heart can never be measured.

lines.japanese:
心はどのような方法をもってしても科学で作り出
すことはできない。
lines.english: Science, by whatever means, can never create the heart.

lines.japanese: 心は、神聖不可侵。
lines.english: The heart is sacred and inviolable.

lines.japanese:
だが時間とともに変化し、やがては別のものにな
ることもある。
lines.english: Yet it changes with time, and may eventually become something else.

lines.japanese:
幼い忍に、心の知識はない。
　人の倫理もない。
　ただ集まった。
lines.english: The young Shinobu knew nothing of the heart. Nothing of human morality. They simply gathered.

lines.japanese:
遊んでみた。
　普通の子供のように、振る舞ってきた。
　学校では孤立することも多かった。
lines.english: He tried playing with them. He had behaved like an ordinary child. At school, he was often alone.

lines.japanese:
が、あずさの見つけたこの秘密基地でだけは―――
友を得ることができた。
lines.english: But only here, at the secret base Azusa had discovered— had he been able to make friends.

lines.japanese:
一ヶ月が過ぎ、一年が経ち。
　何人かの中で、集まりは義務ではなくなりかけて
いた頃。
lines.english: A month went by, then a year. For some of them, the gathering was just beginning to feel like something other than an obligation.

lines.japanese: それは戸惑いの季節―――
lines.english: It was a season of uncertainty—

lines.japanese: 「葉子」
lines.english: “Youko.”
“…Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「裏のアルファルファに水をやっておくんだな」
lines.english: “Make sure you water the alfalfa out back.”

lines.japanese: 「うら」
lines.english: “Out back.”

lines.japanese: 「……いてぇな。なにすんだチビ」
lines.english: “…Ow. What'd you do that for, runt?”

lines.japanese:
「チビで悪かったな。そのうち１８０越えておまえ
　のことギッコンバッタンにしてやる」
lines.english: “Yeah, sorry I'm such a runt. One of these days I'm gonna grow past 180 centimeters and teeter-totter you good.”

lines.japanese:
「だめだな。コレは１００センチで成長が止まる顔
　だ。超チビ面だ」
lines.english: “No chance. You've got the face of someone who'll stop growing at one meter. A total runt face.”

lines.japanese: 「いまより低くなるかっ！」
lines.english: “That's shorter than I am now!”

lines.japanese: 「あー、がんばれがんばれ」
lines.english: “Yeah, yeah. Good luck with that.”

lines.japanese: 「どこいくー」
lines.english: “Where you going?”

lines.japanese: 「ションベン」
lines.english: “Gotta piss.”

lines.japanese: 「黙って行って」
lines.english: “Just go. You don't have to announce it.”
“…Hmph.”

lines.japanese:
「おまえに逆らうと、忍にギッコンバッタンにされ
　るから特別に見逃してやる」
lines.english: “If I get on your bad side, Shinobu'll teeter-totter me, so I'm letting that slide just this once.”

lines.japanese: 「っだよあいつー……きにくわなー、むかつー」
lines.english: “What's his problem…? Don't like him. Makes me mad.”

lines.japanese:
「あんなこと言って、ほんとはこわいからだってば
　さ」
lines.english: “He's just saying that 'cause he's really scared of me. I know he is.”

lines.japanese: 「あなた」
lines.english: “You…”
“Huh?”
“…Never mind.”

lines.japanese: 「気になるな」
lines.english: “Now I wanna know.”

lines.japanese:
「さしでがましいことを言いかけただけ。
　気にしないで」
lines.english: “I was about to say something out of line. Don't worry about it.”

lines.japanese: 「……気になる」
lines.english: “…But now I really wanna know.”

lines.japanese: 「黙っちゃうんだ……いんだけどさ」
lines.english: “You're just gonna clam up…? Fine, I guess.”

lines.japanese: 「……葉子ちゃんのとこでもいこっかな……」
lines.english: “…Maybe I'll go see what Youko's doing…”

lines.japanese: 「言葉、気をつけた方が」
lines.english: “You ought to watch how you talk.”

lines.japanese: 「って？」
lines.english: “Meaning?”

lines.japanese: 「端々が乱れてるようだから」
lines.english: “Some of the things you say sound rather coarse.”

lines.japanese: 「そうかなあ？」
lines.english: “You think so?”

lines.japanese: 「気になる？　イヤ？　だめ？」
lines.english: “Does it bother you? Don't you like it? Is it bad?”

lines.japanese: 「……そこまで言ってない」
lines.english: “…I didn't say all that.”

lines.japanese: 「悪かったら直すよ？」
lines.english: “If it's bad, I'll fix it, okay?”

lines.japanese:
「アイツがいる前で言われると……
　ちょっとキマズイけど」
lines.english: “It's just… kinda awkward when you say it with him around.”

lines.japanese: 「どこが乱れてるって？」
lines.english: “What part sounds coarse?”

lines.japanese: 「その、全体的に……つまり……」
lines.english: “Well, generally… all of it. I mean…”

lines.japanese: 「ええと……」
lines.english: “Um…”

lines.japanese: 「直すよ？」
lines.english: “I'll fix it.”

lines.japanese: 「……やっぱりいい」
lines.english: “…No, never mind.”

lines.japanese: 「はい？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese:
「ひとつ手をつけたら、芋づるになってしまいそう
　だから」
lines.english: “If I corrected one thing, it would probably lead to a whole string of corrections.”

lines.japanese: 「まずいの？」
lines.english: “Is that bad?”

lines.japanese: 「……そちらが、まずいでしょう？」
lines.english: “…Wouldn't that be bad for you?”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 「どうして、って……それはつまり……」
lines.english: “Why…? Because… well…”

lines.japanese: 「いやでしょう？」
lines.english: “You wouldn't like it, would you?”

lines.japanese: 「いやじゃないよ」
lines.english: “I wouldn't mind.”

lines.japanese: 「言いたいことも言わないで、どうすんの？」
lines.english: “If you don’t say what you want to say, what’s the point?”

lines.japanese: 「だから」
lines.english: “So…”

lines.japanese: 「うん？」
lines.english: “Yeah?”

lines.japanese:
「ギッコンバッタンというのは、シーソーのことじゃ
　ないの？」
lines.english: “Doesn't ‘teeter-totter’ just mean a seesaw?”

lines.japanese:
「で、でもアイツも使ってたよ！？
　忍くんにギッコンされるって！？」
lines.english: “B-but he said it too! He said Shinobu was gonna teeter-totter him!”
“…He was ribbing you.”

lines.japanese: 「ヒ肉？」
lines.english: “His ribs?”

lines.japanese: 「……イヤミのこと」
lines.english: “…He was making fun of you.”

lines.japanese:
「うおおおおおっ！
　アイツ～～～ッ！」
lines.english: “Raaaaaagh! That jeeeeeerk!”
“Ribs…”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、戻ってきた」
lines.english: “Whoa, you're back.”

lines.japanese: 「紅緒」
lines.english: “Benio.”

lines.japanese: 「……あずさでいいよ……」
lines.english: “…You can just call me Azusa…”

lines.japanese: 「響きがいい……」
lines.english: “It has a nice sound…”

lines.japanese: 「あずさがいい」
lines.english: “I like Azusa better.”

lines.japanese: 「あずささん」
lines.english: “Miss Azusa.”

lines.japanese: 「だね」
lines.english: “That's right.”

lines.japanese: 「今沙也加ちゃんにシドーされてたよ」
lines.english: “Sayaka was just in-structing me.”

lines.japanese: 「うちのあずさがお世話になりました」
lines.english: “Thank you for taking care of our Azusa.”

lines.japanese: 「……何、言ってるのよ」
lines.english: “…What are you talking about?”

lines.japanese:
「アルファルファに水と愛を注いできたのに……
　飼い主いないです」
lines.english: “I poured water and love on the alfalfa… But its owner isn’t here.”

lines.japanese: 「トイレに注いでる最中じゃないかな」
lines.english: “He's probably pouring something into the toilet right now.”

lines.japanese: 「……あなた」
lines.english: “…You.”

lines.japanese: 「はい？」
lines.english: “Yes?”

lines.japanese: 「……そういう、下品なのは……」
lines.english: “…That sort of vulgarity is…”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「用を足す……葉子足す……」
lines.english: “Doing his business… doing Youko’s business…”

lines.japanese:
「っと、快調だぜ。
　オレ様のアルファルファはどうだった？」
lines.english: “Ahh, everything's running smoothly. How's my alfalfa?”

lines.japanese: 「全部枯れてました」
lines.english: “It had all withered.”

lines.japanese: 「何ぃっ！？」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 「わはは、ぶざまー」
lines.english: “Ha! What a loser.”

lines.japanese: 「生き生きとしていたぞ！！」
lines.english: “It was thriving!”

lines.japanese: 「……なんちゃって」
lines.english: “…Just kidding.”

lines.japanese: 「遅いんだ！！」
lines.english: “Bit late for that!”

lines.japanese: 「だいたい、あんな草どうすんだよ」
lines.english: “What're you gonna do with grass like that, anyway?”

lines.japanese: 「食う。おやつだ」
lines.english: “Eat it. It's a snack.”

lines.japanese: 「しょぼいおやつだ」
lines.english: “That's a lousy snack.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえにはやらん」
lines.english: “You're not getting any.”

lines.japanese: 「いらね」
lines.english: “Don't want it.”

lines.japanese:
「今はまだアルファルファもやしだけだが、そのう
　ち凄いことになるぜ。そのときになって後悔する
　がいいさ」
lines.english: “They might only be alfalfa sprouts right now, but someday they're going to be incredible. And when they are, you'll be sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「もやし……」
lines.english: “Sprouts…”

lines.japanese: 「おまえには給料としてくれてやる」
lines.english: “You can have some as your wages.”

lines.japanese: 「わぁい……」
lines.english: “Yaaay…”

lines.japanese: 「元気がないやつだ。肉食えよ」
lines.english: “You sure don't have much energy. Eat some meat.”
“Yes…”

lines.japanese: 「斎くん、今日しずかだね。おなかいたいの？」
lines.english: “You're quiet today, Itsuki. Does your tummy hurt?”

lines.japanese: 「ん、いや……考え事が」
lines.english: “Mm, no… I was just thinking.”

lines.japanese: 「悩み事か」
lines.english: “Something bothering you?”
“Sort of…”

lines.japanese: 「話していいぞ。聞いてやってもいいぞ」
lines.english: “Go on, tell me. I might even listen.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、いいんだ……その、個人的なことだ……」
lines.english: “No, it's fine… It's, uh, personal…”

lines.japanese: 「当てよっか。んーと……」
lines.english: “Want me to guess? Hmm…”

lines.japanese: 「ズバリ、おなかがいたい」
lines.english: “I know! Your tummy hurts.”

lines.japanese: 「下級人間だなおまえは」
lines.english: “You're a pretty low-grade human being.”

lines.japanese: 「なんかすっごく失礼なこと言われた」
lines.english: “I feel like you just said something really rude.”
“…The truth is…”

lines.japanese: 「俺はすごく無口なんだ」
lines.english: “I'm actually a very quiet person.”

lines.japanese: 「え、あに？　聞こえなかった」
lines.english: “Huh? Wha? I didn't hear you.”

lines.japanese: 「無口なやつは嫌いか？」
lines.english: “Do you dislike quiet people?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、ぜんぜん」
lines.english: “Nope. Not at all.”

lines.japanese: 「なら、俺は無口だ」
lines.english: “Then I'm quiet.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: 「よくわからんけどな、まあ好きにすりゃいい」
lines.english: “No clue what this is about, but do whatever you want.”

lines.japanese: 「……ああ、そうする」
lines.english: “…Yeah. I will.”

lines.japanese:
「つきあいがイヤだから黙り込むんじゃないと、
　信じてくれればそれでいい」
lines.english: “All I ask is that you believe I don't go quiet because I hate your company.”

lines.japanese: 「なーんだ。今まで無理してたんだ」
lines.english: “Ohhh. So you've been forcing yourself to talk this whole time.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ……な」
lines.english: “More or less…”

lines.japanese: 「本当は、話すの苦手？」
lines.english: “Is talking actually hard for you?”

lines.japanese: 「許されるのなら」
lines.english: “If that's allowed.”

lines.japanese: 「問題ないよねぇ？」
lines.english: “That's not a problem, is it?”

lines.japanese: 「兄はマジです」
lines.english: “My brother's serious.”

lines.japanese: 「いいことだ」
lines.english: “It's a good thing.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえは見習え」
lines.english: “You should learn from him.”

lines.japanese:
「オレはもうレベル９９だから何も見習う必要はな
　いな」
lines.english: “I'm already level ninety-nine. There's nothing left for me to learn.”
“…Wow.”

lines.japanese: 距離を確かめながら、少年少女は話す。
lines.english: The boys and girls talked as they felt out the distance between them.

lines.japanese:
わからないことが多すぎる。
　どこまでが許されるのか。
　いかにして触れるべきか。
lines.english: There was so much they did not know. What was permitted? How should they touch one another?

lines.japanese: 一つ一つが手探りだった。
lines.english: They had to feel their way through every little thing.

lines.japanese:
忍は眩しいものを見ていた。
　遠く、見ていた。
lines.english: Shinobu was gazing at something radiant. Watching it from far away.

lines.japanese:
どれくらいの時間をそうして過ごしたのか。
　目を覚ますと、曲はとだえ、日が落ちかけていた。
lines.english: How much time had he spent like that? When he woke, the music had stopped and the sun was beginning to set.

lines.japanese: そして忍は一人だった―――
lines.english: And Shinobu was alone—

lines.japanese: 「ただいま」
lines.english: “I'm home.”

lines.japanese: 「ご苦労様、忍」
lines.english: “Good work, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 帰宅すると千鳥の出迎えがある。
lines.english: When he got home, Chidori was there to greet him.

lines.japanese: 「泊まりだったんでは？」
lines.english: “Weren't you staying overnight?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、現場のスタッフだけで解決したようなので」
lines.english: “Yes, but apparently the staff on site handled it on their own.”

lines.japanese:
どんなトラブルだったんだろう。
　忍は少し心配になった。
　千鳥の職場は忍のホームポジションである。
lines.english: What kind of trouble had there been? Shinobu was a little worried. Chidori's workplace was his home base.

lines.japanese:
事件が起こったとなれば、多少は心配だ。
　しかしこのとき、忍の胸中を満たしていたのは、
別の懸念であった。
lines.english: An incident there would naturally be cause for concern. But at that moment, another worry was weighing on Shinobu's mind.

lines.japanese:
（まさか……
　暇だからってまた料理とかしてないよな……）
lines.english: (Don't tell me… she got bored and tried to cook again…)

lines.japanese: 「せっかく時間ができたので―――」
lines.english: “Since I ended up with some free time—”

lines.japanese: （おー、まい、がー）
lines.english: (Oh. My. God.)

lines.japanese: 「出前を取っておきました」
lines.english: “I ordered some takeout.”

lines.japanese: 安堵。
lines.english: Relief.

lines.japanese: 「どうかしましたか？」
lines.english: “Is something the matter?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、何も」
lines.english: “No, nothing.”

lines.japanese:
卓について待っていると、加熱された店屋物が出
てきた。
lines.english: As he waited at the table, the reheated takeout was served.

lines.japanese:
義理とはいえ姉である千鳥は、さすがにわかって
いるようで、ざっと四人前の分量。
lines.english: Though not his sister by blood, Chidori seemed to know him well: there were roughly four portions.

lines.japanese:
一人は千鳥の分だ。
　都合三食分を忍が食す。
lines.english: One person's share was Chidori's. Shinobu ate the other three.

lines.japanese: 「いただきます」
lines.english: “Let's eat.”

lines.japanese: 「いただきます」
lines.english: “Let's.”

lines.japanese:
二人で食事を摂る。
　ほとんど会話はない。
lines.english: They ate together. Barely a word passed between them.

lines.japanese:
テレビ等の雑音もまじらない静かな夕餉は、機械
的に過ぎ去っていく。
lines.english: The quiet dinner ran its mechanical course, unaccompanied even by the noise of a television.

lines.japanese:
心中、肉野菜炒めと餃子の取り合わせに至高のも
のを感じながら、忍の箸は活発に動いた。
lines.english: As Shinobu inwardly reveled in the sublime pairing of meat-and-vegetable stir-fry and dumplings, his chopsticks flew.

lines.japanese: 二人が食べ終えたのはほとんど同時だった。
lines.english: They finished at almost exactly the same time.

lines.japanese: 「薬、忘れないように」
lines.english: “Don't forget your medicine.”

lines.japanese:
ただそれだけを告げると、千鳥は食器を重ねて台
所に消えた。
lines.english: That was all she said. Chidori stacked the dishes and disappeared into the kitchen.

lines.japanese:
いつものように薬を服用すると、やることはなく
なる。
lines.english: After taking his medicine as usual, he had nothing left to do.

lines.japanese:
私室には時間を潰せるようなものは何もない。
　本当の意味でのプライベート空間は、忘れ去られ
た遺物に凝縮されている。
lines.english: There was nothing in his room to help pass the time. The only space that was truly his lay compressed within a forgotten relic.

lines.japanese:
ただ眠り、体を横たえるだけの部屋―――
　部屋は内面を映す。
　部屋の有り様は、心象世界そのものだ。
lines.english: A room for nothing but sleeping, for lying down— A room reflects the self. A room's condition is the inner world made manifest.

lines.japanese: かつて忍の内面は、機能だけであった。
lines.english: Once, Shinobu's inner self had been nothing but function.

lines.japanese:
今は違う。
　違うはず。
　廃墟の内に宿った聖域。
lines.english: Now it was different. It should be. A sanctuary that had taken root amid ruins.

lines.japanese:
それは確かに、忍の心と言えるものではないだろ
うか。
lines.english: Surely that could be called Shinobu's heart?

lines.japanese: 求められる要素は多くない。
lines.english: It required very little.

lines.japanese: 彼らが、いること―――
lines.english: That they be there—

lines.japanese:
仲間が一堂に会し、外界から守られていること。
　小さなコミュニティ。
　忍らにとって世界の全てに近い。
lines.english: His friends together in one place, safe from the outside world. A small community. For them, it was nearly the whole world.

lines.japanese:
世界は限りなく広大であるため、個体が全てを知
覚することは不可能だ。
lines.english: The world is boundlessly vast; no individual can perceive all of it.

lines.japanese:
人は進化し世界を広げた。
　外界に視点を向け、無限の広がりをよいものとした。
lines.english: Humanity evolved and expanded its world. It looked outward and embraced endless expansion as good.

lines.japanese: 地に満ちよ。
lines.english: Fill the earth.

lines.japanese:
神は人の子にそう命じたと記される。
　地を埋め尽くして、海に、空に、空の先に、無限に。
lines.english: It is written that God so commanded the children of man. Fill the land, then the sea, the sky, and what lies beyond the sky—without end.

lines.japanese:
極限まで膨張することは破滅と同義だ。
　だから広がるという行為は完全には肯定されるべ
きものではない。
lines.english: Expansion to the absolute limit is synonymous with ruin. Expansion, then, cannot be endorsed without reservation.

lines.japanese:
世界が有限であるためだ。
　どこかで、折り合いをつけなければならない。
　人の文化が停滞したように。
lines.english: For the world is finite. Somewhere, a compromise must be made. Just as human culture has stagnated.

lines.japanese:
そもそも個体の知覚できる範囲は、さらに限られ
たものである。
lines.english: The range of any one individual's perception is narrower still.

lines.japanese:
個にとって、人類の版図が拡大する意味は、今や
ほとんど失われている。
lines.english: For the individual, the expansion of humanity's domain has all but lost its meaning.

lines.japanese:
自分の居場所があれば良い。
　だからこそ、衰退ははじまったのかも知れない。
　辿り着くのは、聖域の個室化でしかない。
lines.english: A place of one's own is enough. Perhaps that is precisely why decline began. The only destination is sanctuary reduced to a private room.

lines.japanese:
一人一人のエゴと合致する心地よい場所は、心の
うちにしかないのだから。
lines.english: For a comfortable place suited to each person’s ego can exist only within the mind.

lines.japanese:
授業の準備を整えるうち、忍はうつらうつらと船
をこぎ出した。
lines.english: While getting ready for class, Shinobu began to nod off.

lines.japanese:
夢現、その狭間。
　忍は感謝の気持ちでいっぱいになる。
　世界に、運命に、仲間に。
lines.english: Between dream and waking. Shinobu was filled with gratitude. For the world, for fate, for his friends.

lines.japanese:
共有できる聖域が与えられたことを、今だけは幸
とする。
lines.english: For this moment alone, he counted it a blessing to have been given a sanctuary they could share.

lines.japanese: （歯……磨かないと……）
lines.english: (Have to… brush my teeth…)

lines.japanese:
今という幸福な時期が、少しでも続けば良いと
貴宮忍は切に考えている。
lines.english: Shinobu Atemiya wished with all his heart that this happy time might last even a little longer.

lines.japanese:
午前二時半。
　目が覚めた。
　穏やかな起床とはほど遠い。
lines.english: Two thirty in the morning. He woke. It was anything but a peaceful awakening.

lines.japanese:
午前二時半。
　草木も眠る頃合い。最後の一分が過ぎようとして
いる。
lines.english: Two thirty in the morning. The hour when even the grass and trees slept. Its final minute was about to tick by.

lines.japanese:
だとするならば、人は二時半より早く目覚めては
いけないのではないかと貴宮忍は考える。
lines.english: If that was so, Shinobu Atemiya thought, perhaps no one ought to wake any earlier than half past two.

lines.japanese: たまに考える。
lines.english: It was something he wondered from time to time.

lines.japanese:
二時半。早起きという範疇を超える。
　仮眠。ないしは休息―――
　より以上、適した言葉が思いつかない。
lines.english: Two thirty. Far beyond mere early rising. A nap. Or perhaps a rest— He could think of no better word.

lines.japanese:
深夜十二時に寝て二時半前に起きる行為を、解説
する適した言葉はないのではないか。
lines.english: Perhaps there was no proper term for going to sleep at midnight and waking again before half past two.

lines.japanese:
強烈な覚醒。
　心地よくはない。決して。
　それは毒性の刺激だから。
lines.english: A brutal awakening. Not pleasant. Not in the least. A toxic jolt.

lines.japanese:
眠気は胎内に濃く沈殿しているのに、再び横たわ
っても就眠は難しそうだった。
lines.english: Drowsiness still lay dense and heavy inside him, yet even if he lay down again, sleep seemed unlikely.

lines.japanese:
眠りたいのに眠れないのは、苦しいことだ。
　諦めて精神が落ち着くまで、他のことをしていた
方がいい。
lines.english: Wanting sleep and being unable to find it was agony. Better to give up and occupy himself until his mind settled than keep trying.

lines.japanese:
するべきこと。
　忍は大きく息を吐く。
　心臓がドキドキしている。
lines.english: Something he ought to do. Shinobu let out a long breath. His heart was pounding.

lines.japanese:
無水カフェインを大量に摂取した時のように。
　あるいは悪夢から目覚めた時のように。
　唐突に肌が粟立つ。
lines.english: As though he had consumed a massive dose of anhydrous caffeine. Or woken from a nightmare. Gooseflesh rose without warning.

lines.japanese: 底なし沼に沈められた瞬間を連想させ、慄然とする。
lines.english: The thought of being plunged into a bottomless bog made him shudder.

lines.japanese:
底冷えするような震え。悪寒。
　自分の肩を抱いて、体を縮める。
lines.english: A cold that reached his bones. A shiver. He wrapped his arms around his shoulders and curled into himself.

lines.japanese:
こんな時、じっと身じろぎせずに耐えることが、
忍の知恵だ。
lines.english: At times like this, Shinobu's rule was to hold perfectly still and endure.

lines.japanese:
身体を刺激しないよう、浅い呼吸を繰り返す。
　吐き気。
　我慢して、震える。
lines.english: He kept his breathing shallow, careful not to put any strain on his body. Nausea. He bore it, trembling.

lines.japanese:
一分……二分……どれくらい経ったろうか。
　体調を巡る領土争いの趨勢は、忍耐力側に傾きつ
つあった。
lines.english: One minute… two… How long had passed? In the battle for dominion over his body, the tide was beginning to turn in favor of endurance.
“…Hah.”

lines.japanese:
今までとは異なった、重く濁った息を吐く。
　体内の悪しきものを込めたつもりだった。
　呪いのような息だった。
lines.english: He let out a different breath this time, heavy and foul. He imagined it carrying the evil things inside him. It came out like a curse.

lines.japanese:
津波のような吐き気が去ると、ようやくまともに
考えられる。
lines.english: When the tidal wave of nausea receded, he could finally think clearly.
“…That… feeling…”

lines.japanese:
虫だ。虫がいる。
　群生している。
　家の外を埋め尽くしている。
lines.english: Insects. There were insects. Massing in swarms. Filling every space outside the house.

lines.japanese:
キチキチと間断ない音。
　泣き声か、あるいは体の擦れる気配か。
　窓の外を埋めている。
lines.english: A ceaseless chittering. Cries, perhaps, or the sound of bodies rasping together. It filled the world beyond the window.

lines.japanese:
景色しか見えない。
　だが洪水のように世界を埋めている。
　忍は助からない。
lines.english: Only the landscape was visible. Yet they flooded the world like a deluge. There would be no saving Shinobu.

lines.japanese: やがて圧力で窓が破れ、忍は虫の海に呑み込まれる。
lines.english: At last the pressure would shatter the window, and the sea of insects would swallow him.

lines.japanese:
おぞましい想像。
　悪寒はそんな怪奇幻想を土壌としていた。
lines.english: A loathsome vision. The chill had taken root in that grotesque fantasy.

lines.japanese:
心が砕けた瞬間、奇声を発して暴れ、やがては正
気を手放すことになる。
lines.english: The instant his mind shattered, he would scream and thrash, then finally surrender his sanity.

lines.japanese:
願わくば窓が破れる前に狂ってしまえますように。
　あるいは、豆腐の角に頭をぶつけるのが良いだろ
う、とも考えた。
lines.english: He prayed he might go mad before the window broke. Or perhaps he ought to dash his head against the corner of a block of tofu.

lines.japanese: 愕然とする。
lines.english: He was stunned.

lines.japanese:
寝る前に服用しなければならなかった薬を、飲ま
なかったせいだと気付いたからだ。
lines.english: Then he realized why: he had forgotten to take the medicine he needed before bed.

lines.japanese: （しまった……忘れていた……！）
lines.english: (Damn it… I forgot…!)

lines.japanese:
薬の副作用はつらい。
　吐き気、発疹、悪寒、悪夢……。
　群れをなして襲いかかってくる。
lines.english: The medicine's side effects were brutal. Nausea, rashes, chills, nightmares… They came at him in a pack.

lines.japanese:
きつい薬を飲まなければならない日、忍は憂鬱に
なる。
lines.english: Whenever he had to take the potent medicine, Shinobu sank into gloom.

lines.japanese: だから考えないようにして、そして忘却してしまう。
lines.english: So he tried not to think about it, and ended up forgetting.

lines.japanese:
より上位の苦しみを忘れてしまう。
　世界を満たす虫。
　生理的嫌悪感に直結するイメージだ。
lines.english: He forgot the greater suffering. Insects filling the world. An image that struck directly at visceral revulsion.

lines.japanese:
到底、受け入れられない。
　だから薬はまだましだ。
lines.english: It was utterly unbearable. The medicine was better than that.
“…Ow… damn it…”

lines.japanese:
頭痛までする。
　頭蓋にドリルで穴をあけるような苦痛がする。
lines.english: A headache, too. Pain like a drill boring into his skull.
“…Ugh… ngh…”

lines.japanese:
慌てて机に手を伸ばした。引き出しの中。
　粉薬のパック。
lines.english: He reached frantically into his desk drawer. A packet of powdered medicine.

hyperlinks.preview: Primary ingredient: wheat flour—

japaneseHyperlinks.preview: Primary ingredient: wheat flour—

lines.japanese:
それはどういう薬だったろうか？
　思い出せない。
lines.english: What had this medicine been for? He could not remember.

lines.japanese:
迷って、半分だけ口に注ぎ込む。
　水で胃袋に流した。
lines.english: After hesitating, he poured half the packet into his mouth. He washed it down with water.
“Haaah…”

lines.japanese:
再び、忍耐を強いられる。
　今度は長い。
　五分。十分―――
lines.english: Once again, he was forced to endure. This time, it would be a long wait. Five minutes. Ten—

lines.japanese: 十五分―――
lines.english: Fifteen minutes—

lines.japanese:
ずっと食いしばっていた歯が、かすかに開く。
　喘ぎが漏れた。
lines.english: His teeth, clenched all this time, finally eased apart. A gasp escaped.
(…It worked…)

lines.japanese:
覿面であった。
　先ほどまでの苦痛が嘘のようだ。
　実体のない感覚というものが、幻に近い。
lines.english: The effect was unmistakable. The agony of moments before might never have existed. A sensation without substance was little more than a phantom.

lines.japanese:
たとえるなら、苦しみは剥き身の忍を焦がすよう
なもの。
lines.english: The suffering, if he were to put it into an image, had been a flame searing Shinobu's naked self.

lines.japanese:
今は、全身に薄膜をまとっている。
　一度効果を発揮しはじめた薬は、時とともに薄膜
を何枚も重ねてくれる。
lines.english: Now his whole body was sheathed in a thin film. Once the medicine began to work, it laid down film after film as time passed.

lines.japanese:
世界が鈍くなる。
　細かで膨大な世界を、その気配を、感じなくて済む。
lines.english: The world grew numb. He no longer had to feel its immensity and infinite detail—its presence.

lines.japanese:
虫を感じなくて済む。
　不快感と遮断される。
　安心できる。
lines.english: He no longer had to feel the insects. The revulsion could not reach him. He was safe.

lines.japanese:
だが……不安だけは消えない。
　この苦痛とは一生のつきあいになるだろう。
　命に別状はない。不快なだけだ。
lines.english: But… the anxiety alone would not fade. This suffering would probably stay with him for life. It would not kill him. It was only unpleasant.

lines.japanese:
薬の効果は長い年月をかけて、次第に鈍っていく
だろう。
lines.english: Over the years, the medicine would probably gradually lose its effect.

lines.japanese:
あの苦痛に生で接していかねばならない時期が訪
れる。
lines.english: The time would come when he had to face that agony raw.

lines.japanese:
いずれ慣れなければならないのに。
　握りしめる。
　手の中に、乾いた感触があった。
lines.english: He would have to learn to live with it eventually. His fist tightened. Something dry lay in his palm.

lines.japanese: 何かと手を開いて確かめると、服用した薬の空袋。
lines.english: He opened his hand to see what it was: the empty medicine packet.

lines.japanese:
そう―――今はまだ、手放せない。
　分泌によってもたらされた揺籃の中、忍は己が小
心を恥じる。
lines.english: Yes—for now, he still could not let it go. Cradled by the workings of his own chemistry, Shinobu felt ashamed of his cowardice.

lines.japanese: 「……駄目人間」
lines.english: “…I'm hopeless.”

lines.japanese:
だがいずれは、この苦痛さえも受け入れる時が来
るのだ。
lines.english: Yet one day, the time would come to accept even this suffering.

lines.japanese:
そして苦痛さえも感じなくなる時が。
　窓をあけはなつ。
　吹き込む冷気。
lines.english: And then would come a time when even pain ceased to register. He flung the window open. Cold air poured in.

lines.japanese:
それまでは、友達なるものが欲しい。
　矮小な心の慰めとして―――
　せめて今は夢を。
lines.english: Until then, he wanted whatever it was people called friends. To comfort his small heart— For now, at least, let him dream.

lines.japanese: 様々な、夢を―――
lines.english: Dreams of every kind—

lines.japanese: 「オレ様、刑事」
lines.english: “Me—the detective.”

lines.japanese: 「弟子一号」
lines.english: “Apprentice Number One.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes, sir.”

lines.japanese: 「弟子二号」
lines.english: “Apprentice Number Two.”

lines.japanese:
「今日も通報があり次第出動し、街の平和をいい感
　じでキーピングするぞ」
lines.english: “Today, as always, we deploy the moment a report comes in and keep the peace around town in style!”

lines.japanese: 「いいことだよね」
lines.english: “That's a good thing, right?”

lines.japanese: 「ダイナマイト！」
lines.english: “Dynamite!”

lines.japanese: 「どうした小型」
lines.english: “What's wrong, Small Fry?”

lines.japanese: 「小型言うな」
lines.english: “Don't call me small!”

lines.japanese: 「納得いかない」
lines.english: “I'm not buying this.”

lines.japanese: 「なぜだ。カリスマを考えれば当然のことだ」
lines.english: “Why not? With charisma like mine, it's only natural.”

lines.japanese: 「……刑事の弟子ってなにさ」
lines.english: “…What even is a detective's apprentice?”

lines.japanese: 「気にするな」
lines.english: “Don't worry about it.”

lines.japanese: 「聞いたことないよ」
lines.english: “I've never heard of one.”

lines.japanese: 「まあまあ」
lines.english: “Now, now.”

lines.japanese: 「忍君が刑事やればいいのに」
lines.english: “Shinobu should be the detective.”

lines.japanese:
「何を言う。オレ様以外に、ジャスティスがつとま
　るものかよ！」
lines.english: “What are you talking about? Who but me could possibly play the part of Justice?!”

lines.japanese: 「あたまいたいよ、ばか」
lines.english: “You're making my head hurt, stupid.”

lines.japanese:
「なんと失礼なつぶつぶオレンジだ。
　おい飼い主！　貴様のせいだぞ！」
lines.english: “What an impertinent little pulpy orange. Hey, owner! This is your fault!”

lines.japanese: 「すいません」
lines.english: “Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「こらー！　飼い主ってなんだ！」
lines.english: “Hey! What's this 'owner' crap?!”

lines.japanese:
「貴様は忍のペットみたいなものじゃないか、
　シット！」
lines.english: “You’re basically Shinobu’s pet, aren’t you? Sit!”

lines.japanese: 「ペ、ペットぉ～？」
lines.english: “H-His pet…?”

lines.japanese: 「そんな……ペットだなんて……ゆわれても……」
lines.english: “But… if ya call me his pet… I dunno…”

lines.japanese: 「いわれても」
lines.english: “If you call me his pet.”

lines.japanese: 「いわれても」
lines.english: “If you call me his pet.”

lines.japanese: 「……いわれても」
lines.english: “…If you call me his pet.”

lines.japanese: 「ＧＯＯＤ」
lines.english: “GOOD.”

lines.japanese: 「ＧＯＯＤ」
lines.english: “GOOD.”

lines.japanese:
「とにかく、そんなのはドキドキしちゃうんだ！
　ダメなんだ！」
lines.english: “Anyway, that kind of thing gets my heart pounding! I can't handle it!”

lines.japanese: 「意味わからん」
lines.english: “I have no idea what you're talking about.”

lines.japanese: 「クールに行こうぜ、二号」
lines.english: “Play it cool, Number Two.”

lines.japanese: 「ふんだ！」
lines.english: “Hmph!”

lines.japanese: 「……でもちょっとメンツが少なくて寂しくない？」
lines.english: “…Doesn't it feel a little lonely with only the three of us?”

lines.japanese:
「ううむ、確かに……
　だが無闇に増やしても自己犠牲要員だぞ？」
lines.english: “Hmm. True… But if we add people at random, they'll just be there to make heroic sacrifices.”

lines.japanese: 「……ここはオレが食い止める……」
lines.english: “…I'll hold them off here…”

lines.japanese: 「……今のうちに行けー……」
lines.english: “…Go, while you still can…”

lines.japanese:
「……おまえはあの子を助け出すんだろ、
　行けぇ……」
lines.english: “…You're going to rescue that girl, aren't you? Go…”

lines.japanese: しょんぼり―――
lines.english: Crestfallen—

lines.japanese: 「隊長、事件ですぅ」
lines.english: “Captain, we have a case.”

lines.japanese: 「何が起こった！」
lines.english: “What's happened?!”

lines.japanese: 「……いきなり設定違ってるし……」
lines.english: “…The whole premise changed out of nowhere…”

lines.japanese: 「なはは……」
lines.english: “Ahaha…”

lines.japanese:
「貴宮葉子、弟子一号のソフト愛妻。
　得意技は裏・指返しと魚を焼くこととアリの巣を
　水没させること」
lines.english: “Youko Atemiya, Apprentice Number One's soft and loving wife. My specialties are reverse finger throws, grilling fish, and flooding anthills.”

lines.japanese:
「ディープラブ深海１９５００マリアナ級。
　２Ｐカラーはどどめ色。協力プレイでご懐妊です」
lines.english: “Deep love, depth 19,500—Mariana class. My player-two palette is mulberry purple. Co-op play results in pregnancy.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、妻っぽい！？　ずるい！」
lines.english: “Whoa, she really does sound like a wife! That's cheating!”

lines.japanese: 「今度、式あげるんで来てください」
lines.english: “We're having the ceremony soon. Please come.”

lines.japanese: 「結婚カードっ！？」
lines.english: “The marriage card?!”

lines.japanese: 「先に籍だけ入っているわけだな」
lines.english: “So you two registered the marriage first.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、むしろ籍に先だけ入ってます」
lines.english: “No, more like we’ve only registered the tip.”

lines.japanese: 「キレイさっぱりわからん」
lines.english: “That explains absolutely nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「……先っちょだけ入ってる状態？」
lines.english: “…As in, just the tip?”

lines.japanese: 「俺に問うな」
lines.english: “Don't ask me.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは」
lines.english: “Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: 「あははじゃなくて……」
lines.english: “Don't 'ahaha' at that…”

lines.japanese: 「まあいい。で、事件というのは？」
lines.english: “Never mind. So what's the case?”

lines.japanese:
「はい、実はですね……兄が……兄が……
　人をいっぱい殺してしまったのです」
lines.english: “Well, you see… My brother… My brother… killed a whole lot of people.”

lines.japanese: 「斎が？」
lines.english: “Itsuki did?”

lines.japanese: 「はい……それはもう、いっぱい……」
lines.english: “Yes… A whole lot…”

lines.japanese:
「鍛えに鍛えたコロシの技で、夜道に地下道、
　ブラッドレインという感じでして」
lines.english: “With killing arts he'd honed and honed, through streets at night and underpasses— a regular rain of blood.”

lines.japanese: 「わけわからんが、正義的にはいい感じだ」
lines.english: “I don't know what any of that means, but justice-wise, I like the sound of it.”

lines.japanese: 「ダメじゃん」
lines.english: “That's not okay!”

lines.japanese: 「ミゼットちゃんよ」
lines.english: “Listen, Midget.”

lines.japanese: 「ミゼットって何だよ！」
lines.english: “What the hell is a midget?!”

lines.japanese: 「どんな正義だって、倒すべき悪が必要なんだぜ？」
lines.english: “Every kind of justice needs an evil to defeat, you know.”
“…Whaaat?!”

lines.japanese:
「待って章二、あずさにはまだ本当のことは教えな
　いで」
lines.english: “Wait, Shouji. Don't tell Azusa the truth yet.”

lines.japanese:
「本当のことって、え、えーーー
　ーーーーーーーーーーーーーっ！？」
lines.english: “The truth? Wh-WhAAAAAAAA AAAAAAAAAAAAAAT?!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そこは梅津顔で是非」
lines.english: “Oh, please make an Umetsu face for that.”

lines.japanese: 「……あい？　なに？」
lines.english: “…Huh? A what?”

lines.japanese:
「いいえ、わからなければそれで結構です。
　……むちゅ」
lines.english: “Never mind. If you don't understand, that's fine. …Mwah.”

lines.japanese: 「キ、キスされたっ！！」
lines.english: “S-She kissed me!!”

lines.japanese: 「可愛かったので」
lines.english: “Because you were cute.”

lines.japanese:
「ファーストキスは……
　ファーストキスは……っ！！」
lines.english: “My first kiss… My first kiss…!!”

lines.japanese: 「どうせ夢だしええやん」
lines.english: “It's only a dream, so ain't no big deal.”

lines.japanese: 「なぜ関西っぽい」
lines.english: “What's with the sudden drawl?”

lines.japanese: 「それにおでこだし。大丈夫だよ」
lines.english: “And she only kissed your forehead. You're fine.”

lines.japanese: 「でもおデコファーストが……」
lines.english: “But that was my first forehead kiss…”

lines.japanese: 「こいつのスケールの小ささには震えるぜ」
lines.english: “The sheer pettiness of this girl makes me tremble.”

lines.japanese: 「それよりお菓子でも食べようか」
lines.english: “How about some snacks instead?”

lines.japanese:
「待て待て。おまえは停滞大好きなんだろうが、
　物語が進まない」
lines.english: “Hold it. I know you love nothing more than stasis, but the story isn't moving.”

lines.japanese: 「葉子よ、詳細を」
lines.english: “Youko. Give us the details.”

lines.japanese:
「はい……兄は……人を殺して……殺して……
　コロシ抜いて……」
lines.english: “Yes… My brother… killed, and killed… and just kept on killing…”

lines.japanese: 「そして、伝説に―――」
lines.english: “And so he passed into legend—”

lines.japanese: 「解決済みらしいよ」
lines.english: “Sounds like the case is already closed.”

lines.japanese: 「だー、ちくしょう（棒読み）」
lines.english: “Aww, goddammit. (Deadpan.)”

lines.japanese: 「やる気ねーな」
lines.english: “You're not even trying, are you?”

lines.japanese: 「新しい展開が欲しいね」
lines.english: “We need something to move the story along.”

lines.japanese: 「実は連れてきてます」
lines.english: “Actually, I brought someone with me.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう？」
lines.english: “Oh?”

lines.japanese: 「……もう、います」
lines.english: “…She's already here.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、観葉植物がー！」
lines.english: “Ah! The houseplant!”

lines.japanese: 「なんだってー」
lines.english: “You don't say!”

lines.japanese: 「うおー」
lines.english: “Whoa!”

lines.japanese: 「あそこですぅ」
lines.english: “She's over there.”

lines.japanese:
「笛子！　笛子じゃないか！
　そんなところにステルスしてたなんて、気付かなか
ったよ」
lines.english: “Fueko! It's Fueko! I didn't even notice you were stealthed over there the whole time.”

lines.japanese:
「……人間ってね、自分にとって不自然なものは瞬時
　に察知できるけど、そうではないものは頭で理解し
　ていても見逃してしまうものなのよ」
lines.english: “…People instantly spot anything that seems unnatural to them, but anything else can slip past them even when they understand it intellectually.”

lines.japanese:
「なるほどな。マジックのテクニックにミスディレ
　クションというものがあるが、あれは右手でタネを
　すりかえる間」
lines.english: “I see. There’s a technique in magic called misdirection. While the magician secretly switches things with his right hand—”

lines.japanese:
「左手のオーバーアクションに客の目線を集める……
　というものらしい」
lines.english: “—he draws the audience’s eyes to an exaggerated gesture with his left. Or so I hear.”

lines.japanese:
「客の目線を確認した上で、堂々とタネを仕込んだ
　りするそうだ」
lines.english: “Once he's confirmed where the audience is looking, apparently he can set up the trick right in front of them.”

lines.japanese: 「ミステリー用語だと思ってた」
lines.english: “I thought that was a mystery term.”

lines.japanese: 「よーわからん……」
lines.english: “I don't really get it…”

lines.japanese:
「忍、こいつメモリ増やした方がいいんじゃ
　ないか？」
lines.english: “Shinobu, don't you think we should give this thing more memory?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、その子、拡張性ないんで」
lines.english: “Oh, she doesn't have room for upgrades.”

lines.japanese:
「……発熱しか脳のないキューブマシンが。
　おまえなどブラウジング専用機にしてやる」
lines.english: “…You useless little cube whose only function is generating heat. I'll turn you into a dedicated web-browsing machine.”

lines.japanese: 「わかんないけどすっげぇ失礼だ」
lines.english: “I don't get it, but that was really insulting.”

lines.japanese: 「あんたたち、放置長すぎるわよ」
lines.english: “You've ignored me for way too long.”

lines.japanese: 「おっと、そうだったな」
lines.english: “Whoops. Right you are.”

lines.japanese: 「で、笛子はどういう感じなの？」
lines.english: “So, Fueko, what's your role?”

lines.japanese:
「あたしは教官よ。さあ全員、席について！
　お菓子は片づけて！」
lines.english: “I'm the instructor. Now, everyone, take your seats! Put those snacks away!”

lines.japanese: 「えー、新聞によりますとー」
lines.english: “Uh, according to the newspaper…”

lines.japanese:
「ゆとり教育によって知能低下を引き起こしたとし
　て、１万７千人からなる訴訟原告団が、文部科学
　省を相手に損害賠償を―――」
lines.english: “Claiming that relaxed education caused a decline in intelligence, a class of seventeen thousand plaintiffs has filed suit against the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology seeking damages—”

lines.japanese:
「……笛子、それって自分で勉強しなかった彼らに
　も責任があるんじゃ……？」
lines.english: “…Fueko, don't the people who didn't study on their own bear some responsibility too…?”

lines.japanese:
「ジコセキニンは他人にしか適用されないの。それ
　が２１世紀イズム。それが２１世紀ドリームよ」
lines.english: “Personal responsibility only applies to other people. That's twenty-first-century-ism. That's the twenty-first-century dream.”

lines.japanese: 「シット！　しかしその傲慢さは評価できるぜ」
lines.english: “Shit! Still, I can respect that level of arrogance.”

lines.japanese: 「この国終わりだね」
lines.english: “This country is doomed.”

lines.japanese: 「ゆとりは大切だよねぇ」
lines.english: “Having room to relax is important, though.”
“…No… That's not…”

lines.japanese: 「私も忍さんの、ゆとり教育になりたい」
lines.english: “I want to be Shinobu's personal relaxation program, too.”
“Youko—”

lines.japanese: 「やめてやれ。あずさが泣きそうだ」
lines.english: “Give it a rest. Azusa's about to cry.”

lines.japanese: 「あう、ううう……」
lines.english: “Aww, uuuugh…”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんよ」
lines.english: “I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさい」
lines.english: “I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「おとなのからだの力には……対抗できないよ……」
lines.english: “I can't compete with… a grown woman's body…”

lines.japanese: 「なら三人でしましょう」
lines.english: “Then let's do it together, all three of us.”
“…What?”

lines.japanese: 「こらそこー、無駄口を叩かない」
lines.english: “No chatter over there!”

lines.japanese: 「……そういや姫出てきてないな」
lines.english: “…Come to think of it, the princess hasn't appeared.”

lines.japanese: 「……んー、嫌がるんだよね。こういうの」
lines.english: “…Well, she doesn't like this kind of thing.”

lines.japanese: 「ルール違反だ。呼び出せよ」
lines.english: “That's against the rules. Call her in.”

lines.japanese: 「来てくれないよ」
lines.english: “She won't come.”

lines.japanese: 「忍さんをいじめると出てきますよ」
lines.english: “She'll show up if you pick on Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
「こらー、忍ー！
　あんたー！　るがー！」
lines.english: “Hey, Shinobu! Yeah, you! Rrragh!”

lines.japanese: 「……ご、ごめん」
lines.english: “…S-Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「おっと、渡りに船ってやつだ」
lines.english: “Talk about perfect timing.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、扉がひとりでに開いた……」
lines.english: “Ah! The door opened all by itself…”

lines.japanese: 「むこうに……いる？」
lines.english: “Is she… there?”

lines.japanese: 「……そこにいるのはわかってるんだぜ？」
lines.english: “…We know you're there.”

lines.japanese: 「……こ、このクールな息遣いは……！」
lines.english: “…Th-That cool breathing…!”

lines.japanese: 「……間違いない……ですね……」
lines.english: “…That’s her… all right…”

lines.japanese: 「まさか！？」
lines.english: “No way?!”

lines.japanese: しず……
lines.english: Silently…

lines.japanese: 「……ちのぶ」
lines.english: “…Thinobu.”

lines.japanese:
「幼女が来たあぁぁぁぁ！
　幼女が来たぞぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉ！！」
lines.english: “A little girl is heeeeeere! There's a little girl heeeeeeeeeere!!”

lines.japanese: 「このあたしより小さいっ！？」
lines.english: “She's even smaller than me?!”

lines.japanese: 「わほ、これはこれで」
lines.english: “Whoa. This has its own appeal.”

lines.japanese: 「こらあ！」
lines.english: “Hey!”

lines.japanese: 「大変ですボス！　ミサイルが！」
lines.english: “Boss, this is terrible! A missile!”

lines.japanese: 「なにぃ！？　迎撃しろ！」
lines.english: “What?! Intercept it!”

lines.japanese: 「……ここ警察じゃないのかよ……」
lines.english: “…Weren't we supposed to be the police…?”

lines.japanese:
「みんな、急いでパーツマシンに搭乗してちょうだ
　い！」
lines.english: “Everyone, hurry! Get aboard your Parts Machines!”

lines.japanese:
「千鳥博士！　マジかよ！
　アレはまだ完成してないんだろ！？」
lines.english: “Dr. Chidori! Are you serious?! Those things aren’t finished yet, are they?!”

lines.japanese:
「スゴマジです！　ナーカル・ゲートが開いたので
　す！　今こそビッグ・ヒラニプランが甦る時！」
lines.english: “Super serious! The Nakarl Gate has opened! The time has come for the Big Hirani Plan to rise again!”

lines.japanese: 「……もうなんでもいいや」
lines.english: “…Fine, whatever. I give up.”

lines.japanese: 「まあまあ」
lines.english: “Now, now.”

lines.japanese: 「乗ったぜ！」
lines.english: “I'm aboard!”

lines.japanese: 「空が青いだけだ……」
lines.english: “All I can see is blue sky…”

lines.japanese: 「まあまあ」
lines.english: “Now, now.”

lines.japanese: 『唱えよ、いい感じに！』
lines.english: “Chant it, and make it sound good!”

lines.japanese: 「ダイナマイト！」
lines.english: “Dynamite!”
“…Blast.”

lines.japanese: 「メガネレーザー」
lines.english: “Glasses laser.”

lines.japanese: 「やったね、さすが笛子のレーザーだ！」
lines.english: “We did it! That's Fueko's laser for you!”

lines.japanese:
「油断するな！
　まだ敵は１万７千人くらいいるぜ！」
lines.english: “Don't let your guard down! There are still about seventeen thousand enemies left!”

lines.japanese: 「その繋げ方はマズクないかな……」
lines.english: “Isn’t that a pretty dubious connection to make…?”

lines.japanese: 「『人』って……相手ヒトかよ……」
lines.english: “You said ‘people’… Those are actual humans we're fighting…?”
“Kill! Every! One!”

lines.japanese:
「オレたちの親の年代でもある、無気力ブチ切れ世
　代をたんまりと殺ったぜ！」
lines.english: “We slaughtered a whole bunch of the listless, hair-trigger generation—our parents' generation!”

lines.japanese: 「これでまた世界は平和になったわね」
lines.english: “And once again, the world is at peace.”

lines.japanese: 「なんか楽しいや、もう一回最初から行きたいね」
lines.english: “That was kind of fun. Let's go again from the top.”

lines.japanese: 「いやん……」
lines.english: “Nooo…”

lines.japanese: 「このあとすぐに第二話がはじまるぜ」
lines.english: “Episode Two starts right after this!”

lines.japanese: 「……あれ、そういえば小さい沙也加は？」
lines.english: “…Wait. Where did little Sayaka go?”

lines.japanese: 「今、僕の膝の上に乗せてる」
lines.english: “She's sitting on my lap right now.”

lines.japanese: 「あうー！？」
lines.english: “Awwww?!”
“……Teeny.”

lines.japanese: 「ちまっとしてる。おとなしくて可愛い」
lines.english: “She's so teensy. Quiet and cute.”

lines.japanese:
「あーーーっ！！
　そっちがいー！」
lines.english: “Aaaah!! I wanna be over there!”

lines.japanese:
「こんな爪先ロボの中じゃなくて、
　そっちがいいよう！」
lines.english: “I don’t wanna be stuck inside this robot’s toe! I wanna be over there!”

lines.japanese:
「うるせー、チビはそこに搭乗するって昭和から決
　まってんだー！」
lines.english: “Shut up! The runt rides there. That's been the rule since the Showa era!”

lines.japanese: 「ショウワってなに！？　知らないよ！」
lines.english: “What's Showa?! I don't know what that is!”

lines.japanese: 「……知らないんだ…………」
lines.english: “…You really don't know……”

lines.japanese:
「ゆとり教育の魔の手から、あずさを守っていきま
　しょう、忍」
lines.english: “We must protect Azusa from the evil clutches of relaxed education, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。でもゆとり教育、僕は好きだよ」
lines.english: “Yeah. But I like relaxed education.”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 「……きかん方がいいぞ」
lines.english: “…Better not ask.”

lines.japanese: 「はい？」
lines.english: “Excuse me?”

lines.japanese:
「……国民が勝手にバカになってくれるってんだか
　ら、上に立つ者としては為政が楽になると思うん
　だ（笑顔）」
lines.english: “…If the public is going to dumb itself down all on its own, I think that makes governing easier for those of us at the top. (Smiles.)”

lines.japanese: 「素敵」
lines.english: “Wonderful.”

lines.japanese: 「素敵じゃない！」
lines.english: “No, it isn't!”

lines.japanese: 「ではまた来週」
lines.english: “See you next week.”

lines.japanese: 「こらあ！」
lines.english: “Hey!”

lines.japanese: 「まったく正義を守るのは大変だぜ」
lines.english: “Protecting justice sure is hard work.”

lines.japanese: 「むぎゃーーーーーーーーーっ！」
lines.english: “Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese:
「いいから爪先から出せーーーー
　ーーーーーーーーーーーっ！！」
lines.english: “Just get me out of the toe alreadyyyyyy yyyyyyyyyyyyyy!!”

lines.japanese:
忍は夢に漂っていた。
　目的もなく。
lines.english: Shinobu drifted in a dream. Aimlessly.
(Where… am I?)

lines.japanese:
明晰なもののない世界だった。
　ふと視界が開けた。
lines.english: Nothing in that world was distinct. Then, all at once, the view opened before him.

lines.japanese: （ここは……）
lines.english: (This is…)

lines.japanese: （うちじゃないか）
lines.english: (This is my home.)

lines.japanese:
足が大地を支えている実感を、忍は喪失している。
　宙に浮いているような。
　あるいは、大地が幻であるかのような。
lines.english: Shinobu had lost the sense that his feet were supporting the earth. As though he were floating in midair. Or as though the earth itself were an illusion.

lines.japanese: そんな無の感触に包まれている。
lines.english: That sense of nothingness enveloped him.

lines.japanese: （……何を、していたんだっけ？）
lines.english: (…What had I been doing?)

lines.japanese:
自分が何者か考える。
　貴宮忍。
lines.english: He considered who he was. Shinobu Atemiya.

lines.japanese:
馴染みのある響きだ。
　疑う余地もないほどに。
lines.english: A familiar sound. Familiar beyond all doubt.

lines.japanese:
しかしその疑惑そのものが、信頼に足るものでは
ないことを忍は知っている。
lines.english: Yet Shinobu knew that the doubt itself could not be trusted.

lines.japanese:
感覚的に知っている。
　何が正しいのか、わからなくなってしまう。
lines.english: He knew it instinctively. He could no longer tell what was true.

lines.japanese: （いったい……）
lines.english: (What in the world…)

lines.japanese:
リアルを意識すれば、不確かな中庭で風や芝生の
においさえ感じ取ることができてしまう。
lines.english: If he fixed his mind on reality, he could even smell the wind and grass in that uncertain courtyard.

lines.japanese:
本物の感触さえ、脳内で再現しているのかも知れ
ないというのに。
lines.english: Even though the texture of reality might only be something his brain was reproducing.

lines.japanese: （そういうことを考えるのは……やめよう）
lines.english: (I should stop… thinking about this.)

lines.japanese: （だってこれは……夢だ）
lines.english: (Because this is… a dream.)

lines.japanese: （足がつかないのだから、夢だ）
lines.english: (My feet don't touch the ground, so it must be a dream.)

lines.japanese: 動くこともできないのだ。
lines.english: He could not move either.

lines.japanese: （無意味な、脳のノイズ……）
lines.english: (Meaningless noise from the brain…)

lines.japanese:
寝てしまおうと瞳を閉じかける。
　その寸前に、異物を知覚した。
lines.english: He was about to close his eyes and let sleep take him. Just before they shut, he sensed something foreign.
(…What?)

lines.japanese:
さっきまではいなかった。
　さっきまでは認識していなかった。
lines.english: A moment ago, she had not been there. A moment ago, he had not been aware of her.

lines.japanese:
唐突に対峙していた。
　唐突に認知させていた。
lines.english: Now she was suddenly facing him. Suddenly forcing herself into his awareness.

lines.japanese: 少女―――
lines.english: A girl—

lines.japanese:
存在の不自然さが、忍の脳に負担をかけた。
　許容量以上の事物に触れた時、人は狂う。
lines.english: The unnaturalness of her existence strained Shinobu's brain. Confronted with more than the mind can bear, a person goes mad.

lines.japanese:
白い部屋に閉じこめられた若者が、やがては狂気
に浸されるように。
lines.english: Like a young man locked in a white room, slowly steeped in madness.

lines.japanese: そして目の前に立つのは、少女の形をした不条理だ。
lines.english: And there before him stood an absurdity in the shape of a girl.

lines.japanese: （……この子は……いったい……？）
lines.english: (…What… is this girl?)

lines.japanese:
人懐こい笑みを浮かべる少女の像。
　ある種の好奇を擬態して。
　それが忍には恐ろしい。
lines.english: The image of a girl with an open, friendly smile. An imitation of a certain kind of curiosity. Shinobu found her terrifying.

lines.japanese:
少女の背後に、奈落を感じる。
　決して理解の手が届かない、深い闇。
　いびつな深淵の形。
lines.english: He sensed an abyss behind the girl. A deep darkness forever beyond the reach of understanding. The shape of a warped abyss.

lines.japanese: 歪んだ真珠を思わせる。
lines.english: She brought to mind a misshapen pearl.

lines.japanese: （どうしてこんなに…………おそろしい？）
lines.english: (Why is she so…… terrifying?)

lines.japanese:
相反する視覚と直感に挟まれた時、人は笑ってし
まうのだという。
lines.english: They say that when sight and intuition conflict, a person cannot help but smile.

lines.japanese: 忍の小振りな顔が、きっとそうなっているように。
lines.english: No doubt Shinobu's small face had taken on just such a smile.

lines.japanese: 「飛んで、来たのね」
lines.english: “You came flying in.”
(…What?)

lines.japanese: 「繋ぎ方にミスがあったみたいね」
lines.english: “Looks like there was an error in the way you connected.”

lines.japanese: 「なら、ようこそ」
lines.english: “Then welcome.”
(…What? …What?)

lines.japanese: 「ちょうどまとめ終わったところよ、忍」
lines.english: “I just finished putting it all together, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
「デバッグ前だから、細かい部分でミスがあるのだ
　けれど……ふふ」
lines.english: “It hasn't been debugged yet, so there are small errors here and there… Heh.”

lines.japanese: （なに……笑ってるんだ……これ……）
lines.english: (Why… is this thing laughing…?)

lines.japanese:
肉体が実体を持たない世界。
　魂だけが震えた。
　悪寒となって波打った。
lines.english: A world where the body had no substance. Only his soul trembled. The tremor rippled through him as a chill.

lines.japanese:
背後に殺人鬼が尾行していることに突如気付いた
かのような、底冷えのする竦みだ。
lines.english: A bone-deep paralysis, as though he had suddenly realized a murderer was following him.

lines.japanese:
背後に殺人鬼。
　背後に殺人鬼。
lines.english: A murderer behind him. A murderer behind him.

lines.japanese: どういうわけか、しっくりと来るイメージ。
lines.english: For some reason, the image felt exactly right.

lines.japanese: （でも……おかしい）
lines.english: (But… that's strange.)

lines.japanese: （合致しすぎてる！）
lines.english: (It fits too perfectly!)

lines.japanese: 忍は軽い混乱に襲われた。
lines.english: A flicker of confusion passed through Shinobu.

lines.japanese:
得体の知れぬ場所。
　得体の知れぬ時。
　得体の知れぬ少女。
lines.english: An unknowable place. An unknowable time. An unknowable girl.

lines.japanese: 「ようやく、会えたのね」
lines.english: “At last, we've met.”

lines.japanese: 感慨深く、息を吐く。
lines.english: She let out a breath full of feeling.

lines.japanese:
「もっとはやくこの方法に気付いていれば……
　この会見方法に届いていれば」
lines.english: “If only I'd discovered this method sooner… If only I'd found this way to meet you.”

lines.japanese:
「もっとはやく、この繋がりのミスを導出すること
　ができていれば」
lines.english: “If only I’d worked out the error in this connection sooner.”

lines.japanese: 少女は含み笑いを漏らした。
lines.english: The girl gave a quiet, knowing laugh.

lines.japanese: 「たくさんの呪詛を吐いてやれたのに」
lines.english: “Then I could have showered you with curses.”

lines.japanese: 忍は押し潰されそうになる。
lines.english: Shinobu felt as though he were being crushed.

lines.japanese:
「運が良い。あなたの幸薄い、それでも肉のある人生
　において、これは紛れもない幸運だと思う」
lines.english: “You are lucky. In that ill-fated life of yours—a life still lived in flesh— I think this is unmistakable good fortune.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたの信じるものに感謝を捧げるといいわね」
lines.english: “You should offer thanks to whatever it is you believe in.”
(…She's going to kill……)

lines.japanese: 「殺してやろうと思っていたの」
lines.english: “I was planning to kill you.”

lines.japanese:
忍は竦みあがる。
　ふと声調がかげりを帯び、ソプラノが明度を失う。
lines.english: Shinobu froze in terror. Her tone suddenly darkened; the soprano lost its brightness.

lines.japanese: 「……心を、焼いてやろうって、ずっと」
lines.english: “…All this time, I've wanted to burn out your heart.”

lines.japanese: （……この娘が……敵……なのか？）
lines.english: (…Is this girl… my enemy?)
“But—”

lines.japanese: 邪気が失せる。
lines.english: The malice vanished.

lines.japanese: 「もう少し、時間が必要ね」
lines.english: “I need a little more time.”

lines.japanese: 「……彷徨っていて」
lines.english: “…Keep wandering.”

lines.japanese: 指先が忍を射抜く。
lines.english: Her fingertip pierced Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「ばーん」
lines.english: “Bang.”

lines.japanese:
じくり、と指された箇所が熱くなった。
　忍は認識上の錯覚から、自らの心臓のあたりを見た。
lines.english: A dull heat spread through the spot she had pointed at. Mistaking where it was, Shinobu looked down toward his heart.

lines.japanese: しかし加熱されたのはそこではなかった。
lines.english: But that was not where the heat was.
His brain—
(…Hot!)

lines.japanese:
どこが傷んだのかわからない。
　夢中の怪我とはそういうものだ。
　非現実的で、とらえどころがない。
lines.english: He could not tell what part of him had been hurt. Injuries in dreams were like that. Unreal, impossible to grasp.

lines.japanese: そして少女は口にする。
lines.english: And then the girl spoke.

lines.japanese: 「リロード」
lines.english: “Reload.”
(……What?)

lines.english: “Don't you ‘mm-huh-wha’ me.”

lines.japanese: 沙也加が一同を追い越してゆったりと歩いていった。

lines.japanese: 「遅刻しちまうぜ」
lines.english: “We're going to be late.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、私は急がないと……はい、全員駆け足」
lines.english: “Oh, I need to hurry… All right, everybody—double time.”

lines.japanese: 「えー」
lines.english: “Aww.”
“…Hh… hh…”

lines.japanese: 「おい！　真に受けるなよ斎！　おーい！」
lines.english: “Hey! Don't take her seriously, Itsuki! Hey!”
“…” (blushing)

lines.japanese: 戻ってきた。

lines.japanese: 「普段ぼんやりしてるからそうなる」
lines.english: “That's what you get for always spacing out.”
“……” (blushing)

lines.japanese: 「あはは、斎くんおっかしー」
lines.english: “Ha ha! Itsuki, you're hilarious.”

lines.japanese: 「どした、忍」
lines.english: “What's wrong, Shinobu?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、なんか……いいなって」
lines.english: “No, just… This is nice.”

lines.japanese: 「いいのか、ええのんか」
lines.english: “Oh, it's nice, is it? Is it reeally nice?”
“…Y-yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど……」
lines.english: “I see…”

lines.japanese: 葉子は満足げに頷いた。
lines.english: Youko nodded in satisfaction.

lines.japanese: 「行くか」
lines.english: “Let's go.”

lines.japanese: 「んむ」
lines.english: “Mm.”

lines.japanese: 七人は歩き出した。いつものように。
lines.english: The seven set off, as always.

lines.japanese: 「今日はずいぶんとまた王子様度が高めだな」
lines.english: “Your prince factor is unusually high today.”

lines.japanese: 「……王子様度？」
lines.english: “…My prince factor?”

lines.japanese: 「そのわかっていながらすっとぼけた態度全般だよ」
lines.english: “That whole way you pretend not to know when you understand perfectly well.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、ナニそれ。あはほはほ」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha, what’s that supposed to mean? Ah-ha-ho-ho.”

lines.japanese:
「……舐められてる、このオレが……変な笑われ方
　までされ全霊にて舐められている……」
lines.english: “…He's making fun of me. Me. Even that ridiculous laugh— he's mocking me with every fiber of his being…”

lines.japanese: 「いつもこうだよ」
lines.english: “I'm always like this.”

lines.japanese: 「いや……さすがにそれはどうかなと……」
lines.english: “No… Even I have to question that…”

lines.japanese: 「人に二面性あるみたいなことを……」
lines.english: “You make it sound as if I have two sides…”

lines.japanese: 「あるぞ」
lines.english: “You do.”

lines.japanese: 「あるわよ」
lines.english: “You certainly do.”

lines.japanese: 「ひどいや」
lines.english: “How cruel.”

lines.japanese: 「二面性って？」
lines.english: “Two sides?”

lines.japanese: 「優しい部分と、怖い部分」
lines.english: “A gentle side and a scary side.”

lines.japanese: 彼女にしては珍しく、戯笑う。

lines.japanese: 「なに……ばかな……」

子供の頃は、それでも成立していたのだが、最近

ない。

それが寂しいのか、あずさもむきになって同じ行
為を続けている。
lines.english: Perhaps she missed it, because Azusa stubbornly kept trying anyway.
“…Hmm.”

lines.japanese: 特に拒絶することもなく、適当につきあう。

lines.japanese: 「……ちっ、ダメか……」
lines.english: “…Tch. No good…”

lines.japanese:

lines.english: Giving up on the arm swing, Azusa let go. Their relationship might look unusual from the outside, but to them it was simply part of everyday life.

lines.japanese: 「本当だ」
lines.english: “It really is.”

lines.japanese: 「やわっこいですね。十代処女並に」
lines.english: “Very soft. Like a teenage virgin.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな生き物は実際にはいない」

lines.japanese:
章二は葉子から蹴られた。

lines.english: They still had not stopped touching him.

lines.english: “They say people with cool skin have warm hearts.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ忍くんはホットだね」

lines.english: “Ladies and gentlemen… Please do not touch the dancer.”

lines.japanese: 「章二は見るからに鮫肌ね」
lines.english: “Shouji looks like he's made of sharkskin.”

lines.japanese: 「オレはシャークってことだな」
lines.english: “Meaning I'm a shark.”

lines.japanese: 「……なんでも荒々しい方に取るなよ」
lines.english: “…Why do you have to make everything macho?”

lines.japanese: 「え、うそ？」
lines.english: “What? Really?”

lines.japanese:
確かに、後頭部近くかすかな跳ねっ返りが確認で
きる。
lines.english: Sure enough, a small tuft was sticking up near the back of his head.

lines.japanese: 鏡では見えない角度にあったらしい。
lines.english: It must have been at an angle the mirror couldn't catch.

lines.japanese: 「うわ、もうマヌケだなぁ」
lines.english: “Aw, man. I look like an idiot.”

lines.japanese: 「戻らないな」
lines.english: “Doesn't want to lie down.”

lines.japanese:
「自家に戻る時間もないし、学校でなんとかするし
　かないか……」
lines.english: “No time to go home. Guess I'll have to fix it at school...”

lines.japanese: 「任せろ」
lines.english: “Leave it to me.”

lines.japanese:
章二は鞄の中から、ビニールに包まれた熱々のお
しぼりを取り出した。
lines.english: Shouji pulled a piping-hot, plastic-wrapped hand towel from his schoolbag.

lines.japanese: 「……なんだコイツは……」
lines.english: “…What the hell is with this guy…?”

lines.japanese: おしぼりの尻を平手で叩くと、反対側が弾け飛ぶ。
lines.english: He smacked one end of the wrapper with his palm, popping the towel out the other.

lines.japanese: 「こいつで……」
lines.english: “Now, with this...”

lines.japanese: まだ蒸しタオル状態のソレを、寝癖にかぶせる。
lines.english: He laid the still-steaming towel over the unruly tuft.

lines.japanese: 「取れたな。さすが、定番のテク」
lines.english: “There. Fixed. Can't beat the classics.”

lines.japanese: 「……なぜおしぼりを」
lines.english: “...Why do you have a hot towel?”

lines.japanese:
「昨夜はバイトが終わったあとファミレスで寝てたん
　でな。朝メシ食ったあとに最高に熱いヤツを一本も
　らってきた」
lines.english: “After work last night, I crashed at a family restaurant. Had breakfast this morning and asked them for the hottest towel they had.”

lines.japanese: 「何つー生活プランだ……」
lines.english: “What kind of life plan is that...?”

lines.japanese: 「ついでにちょっと整えてやるぜ」
lines.english: “Might as well style it while I'm at it.”

lines.japanese:
指先が髪をかき回す。
　くすぐったそうに、忍は片目を閉じる。
lines.english: His fingertips raked through Shinobu's hair. Shinobu squeezed one eye shut at the tickle.

lines.japanese: 「モテモテにしてやるぜ」
lines.english: “I'll make you irresistible.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな簡単にもてたらなぁ」
lines.english: “If only it were that easy.”

lines.japanese: 蒸しタオルで髪束を包むように、流れをつけていく。
lines.english: He wrapped sections of hair in the steaming towel, coaxing them into shape.

lines.japanese: 「いい髪質だな。癖もない」
lines.english: “Nice hair. No kinks.”

lines.japanese: 「そうかなぁ？」
lines.english: “You think?”

lines.japanese: 「こんな感じか……？　いや、こういう方が……」
lines.english: “Maybe like this...? No, this way...”

lines.japanese: 「くすぐったいってば」
lines.english: “I said it tickles.”

lines.japanese: 「我慢しろよ」
lines.english: “Put up with it.”

lines.japanese: いちゃいちゃ。
lines.english: Flirting.

lines.japanese: 「……もーいーだろ。はやくしろ」
lines.english: “…That's enough already. Hurry up.”

lines.japanese: あずさの声が低い。
lines.english: Azusa’s voice was low.

lines.japanese:
「ウェットなテイストにちょっと荒々しさを表現し
　てだな」
lines.english: “I'm giving the wet look a touch of wildness, you see.”

lines.japanese: 「無視すんな！」
lines.english: “Don't ignore me!”

lines.japanese: 「静かにしてろチビメス」
lines.english: “Pipe down, runt.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！」
lines.english: “Hah!”

lines.japanese: 臀部に切れ味の良い蹴りが飛ぶ。
lines.english: A sharp kick landed on his backside.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！　ハッ！」
lines.english: “Hah! Hah!”

lines.japanese: 連撃。
lines.english: A combo.

lines.japanese: 「よし、こんなところか」
lines.english: “There. That should do it.”

lines.japanese: 無視。ダメージ０。
lines.english: Ignored. Zero damage.

lines.japanese: 「んー」
lines.english: “Hmm.”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿、さわんな！」
lines.english: “Idiot, don't touch it!”

lines.japanese: 「こんなとこかって言われても確認できない……」
lines.english: “You say it's done, but I can't exactly check...”

lines.japanese: 「これでいい。そのままにしておけ」
lines.english: “It's fine. Leave it alone.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、ホアッ！」
lines.english: “Hah! Hwah!”

lines.japanese: 「行こうか」
lines.english: “Shall we?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ。存分にモテてこい」
lines.english: “Sure. Go knock 'em dead.”

lines.japanese: 「どりゃー、ずりゃー」
lines.english: “Hraah! Zraah!”

lines.japanese: 「ふぁぁ」
lines.english: “Fuaaah.”

lines.japanese: キックを黙殺し、欠伸を噛み殺す。
lines.english: He ignored the kicks and stifled a yawn.

lines.japanese: 「そうね」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 「はぁ、はぁ……くっ、やせ我慢を！」
lines.english: “Hah, hah… Tch! You’re just pretending it doesn’t hurt!”

lines.japanese: 「軽いんだよおまえの蹴りは。効かんな」
lines.english: “Your kicks are too light. I can't feel a thing.”

lines.japanese: 「今に見てろよ、レベル８５から急成長してやる」
lines.english: “Just you wait. Once I hit level eighty-five, my stats'll skyrocket.”

lines.japanese: 「遠い道程だな。せいぜい頑張るんだな」
lines.english: “Long way to go. Do your best, I suppose.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえも頑張れよ！」
lines.english: “You do your best!”

lines.japanese: 再び、スパコンスパコン蹴りが飛ぶ。
lines.english: Another flurry of hollow thwacks.

lines.japanese: 「……飼い主、この荒ぶる狂獣をなんとかしろ」
lines.english: “...Owner, do something about this rampaging beast.”

lines.japanese: 「無理なんだよね」
lines.english: “Can't be done.”

lines.japanese: 「鬱陶しすぎるぞ……」
lines.english: “She's beyond annoying…”

lines.japanese: 「まあ気に入られてるってことだから、我慢して」
lines.english: “It means she likes you. Try to put up with it.”

lines.japanese: 「奇怪なことを言うな」
lines.english: “Don't say bizarre things.”

lines.japanese: 「あははは」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha.”

lines.japanese: 「しっ、しっ！」
lines.english: “Shoo! Shoo!”

lines.japanese:
自分で風切り音を再現しながら、嫉妬まじりのあ
ずさの猛攻は続けられた。
lines.english: Making her own whooshing sound effects, Azusa kept up her fierce assault, tinged with jealousy.

lines.japanese:
極度の緊張を強いられている。
　果たして、実戦でおのが力は役立つものだろうか。
lines.english: She was under extreme pressure. Would her abilities hold up in actual combat?

lines.japanese:
張りつめた表情には、どこか不安も混じっている。
　実戦ではたった一つのミスが命取りになる。
lines.english: Anxiety lurked beneath her rigid expression. In the field, a single mistake could prove fatal.

lines.japanese:
脚の震えなどもたいしたことのないように思われる
が、もし意識してしまえば腰が抜けて動けなくなる。
lines.english: Trembling legs might not sound serious, but if she became aware of them, her knees might buckle and leave her unable to move.

lines.japanese:
動けない兵士は戦場では生きていけない。
　兵士は移動力が全てだからだ。
lines.english: A soldier who could not move could not survive on the battlefield. Mobility was everything to a soldier.

lines.japanese:
下半身の統制を乱す怯えは、心までをも麻痺させ
てしまうに違いない。
lines.english: The fear disrupting command of her lower body would surely paralyze her mind as well.

lines.japanese:
だが脚だけならばなんとかなる。
　気を張って集中することで、なんとか抑えること
ができる。
lines.english: But legs alone could be managed. By staying alert and focusing, she could keep them more or less under control.

lines.japanese:
これが全身となると、話は別だ―――
　人間の体で、精神的な要因によって制御を逸脱す
る箇所はいくらでもある。
lines.english: If her whole body began to tremble, that was another matter— there were countless parts of the human body that could slip free of control under psychological strain.

lines.japanese:
指先、唇、舌、まぶた、眼球、胃袋……。
　特に舌は危険である。
　本作戦の要と言っても良い重要部位ではないか。
lines.english: Fingertips, lips, tongue, eyelids, eyeballs, stomach... The tongue was especially dangerous. Was it not the linchpin of the entire operation?

lines.japanese:
あずさは自らの弱気を押し潰すように、ぐっと拳
を握った。
lines.english: Azusa clenched her fist as if crushing her own timidity.

lines.japanese: 「今度の日曜日、あちきと―――」
lines.english: “This Sunday, how's about you and li'l ol' me—”

lines.japanese: 「ばかーーーーーーーー！」
lines.english: “Stuuuuuuuuupid!”

lines.japanese: 顔を覆った。
lines.english: She covered her face.

lines.japanese: 「あちきってなんだ……極道の妻か……」
lines.english: “What’s this ‘li’l ol’ me’…? Am I a mobster’s wife…?”

lines.japanese: あずさは恋をかなえるため、作戦を練っている。
lines.english: Azusa was devising a strategy to make her love a reality.

lines.japanese: 愛の兵士としてのスキルは、まだまだ低い。
lines.english: Her skills as a soldier of love remained woefully underdeveloped.

lines.japanese: 「ごほごほ、あーあー」
lines.english: “Ahem, ahem. Ah, ah.”

lines.japanese:
咳払い。
　深呼吸。
　シャドー。特に意味のない行動。
lines.english: A clearing of the throat. A deep breath. Shadowboxing. For no particular reason.

lines.japanese:
正拳の構え。攻めの心情を示しているのかも知れ
ない。
lines.english: She assumed a straight-punch stance. Perhaps it expressed her determination to go on the offensive.
“All right...”

lines.japanese: カッと瞳を見開く。
lines.english: Her eyes flew wide open.

lines.japanese: 「今度の日曜日、映画を見に行こうと思います！」
lines.english: “I’m thinking of going to see a movie this Sunday!”
“The! End!”

lines.japanese:
ぼふ。
　ソファに沈んだ。
lines.english: Whump. She sank into the sofa.

lines.japanese: 「最後の最後で、逃げを……」
lines.english: “I chickened out at the very end...”

lines.japanese:
日頃、忍になにくれとなくまとわりつくあずさだ。
　なのにデートという認識一つで、全ての歯車が狂
ってしまっている。
lines.english: Ordinarily, Azusa clung to Shinobu at every opportunity. Yet the mere thought of calling this a date had thrown every gear out of alignment.

lines.japanese: 「……情報詰め込みすぎなんだな……たぶん」
lines.english: “I must've crammed in too much information… probably.”

lines.japanese:
いい所に気がついた。
　情報量が多いと、混乱してしまう。
lines.english: She had put her finger on the problem. Too much information only confused her.

lines.japanese: 「シンプルに誘えばいいんだよね」
lines.english: “I just need to keep it simple.”

lines.japanese: 「よし……おほん」
lines.english: “All right... ahem.”

lines.japanese:
咳払い。
　深呼吸。
　シャドー。
lines.english: A clearing of the throat. A deep breath. Shadowboxing.

lines.japanese: 正拳。
lines.english: A straight punch.

lines.japanese: 「映画見にいこう」
lines.english: “Let's go see a movie.”

lines.japanese: そんなことを言われたら、忍はこう問いかけるだろ。
lines.english: If she said that, Shinobu would ask:

lines.japanese: 「いつ？」
lines.english: “When?”

lines.japanese: 慌てず対応すれば良い。
lines.english: All she had to do was answer without panicking.

lines.japanese: 「次の日曜とか」
lines.english: “Maybe next Sunday.”

lines.japanese: チケットは？
lines.english: And the tickets?

lines.japanese: 「少ないお小遣いから確保してある」
lines.english: “Already bought them out of my meager allowance.”

lines.japanese: 洋服は？
lines.english: And clothes?

lines.japanese:
「……よくわかんないしなぁ。とりあえず、いつも
　の格好で」
lines.english: “…I don't know anything about clothes. I'll just wear what I always wear.”

lines.japanese: 二度三度頷くあずさ。
lines.english: Azusa nodded to herself two or three times.

lines.japanese: 「……うん、かむぺき」
lines.english: “...Yup. Perfick.”

lines.japanese: 「これで行こう。必要最低限の構成」
lines.english: “That's the plan. Bare minimum configuration.”

lines.japanese: 最善の作戦がここに立案された。
lines.english: Thus was the optimal strategy devised.

lines.japanese: 気がつくと、もう夕方。
lines.english: Before she knew it, evening had come.

lines.japanese: 「今日はみんな来ないのかな……」
lines.english: “Maybe nobody's coming today…”

lines.japanese:
この時間になって来なければ、自宅に直帰してい
るのだろう。
lines.english: If they hadn't come by now, they had probably gone straight home.

lines.japanese: 「……かえろ」
lines.english: “...I'll go home.”

lines.japanese: いそいそと身支度を整え、工場をあとにした。
lines.english: She briskly gathered her things and left the factory.

lines.japanese: さて―――
lines.english: And then—

lines.japanese: 「……やっと帰ってくれた……」
lines.english: “…Finally, she went home…”

lines.japanese:
一時間ほど、身動きが取れなかった忍である。
　珈琲を淹れている隙にあずさがやってきて、声を
かけにくい世界を短時間で作り上げた。
lines.english: Shinobu had been trapped there, unable to move, for about an hour. Azusa had arrived while he was making coffee and quickly created a world in which it was hard to speak to her.

lines.japanese:
なんとなくあずさの意図はわかる。
　が、普段抵抗なく会話しているのに、なぜ改めて
緊張しているのかが理解できない。
lines.english: He had a fair idea what Azusa was trying to do. But he could not understand why, when she normally talked to him without hesitation, she was suddenly so nervous about it now.

lines.japanese: 「疲れた……」
lines.english: “I'm exhausted...”

lines.japanese:
息を殺していたため、珈琲のことも忘れていた。
　手にしたカップで、冷めてしまっている。
lines.english: He had been holding his breath and forgotten all about the coffee. It had gone cold in the cup in his hand.

lines.japanese: 一瞬ためらってから、一息に飲み干した。
lines.english: After a moment's hesitation, he drained it in one gulp.

lines.japanese: 「……まずい」
lines.english: “...Awful.”

lines.japanese:
渋味の増した液体がそうさせたのか、頭が冴えた。
　あずさと出会ってから数年が経つ。
　今でも充分に楽しく充実した日々だと思う。
lines.english: Perhaps its increased astringency had sharpened his mind. It had been several years since he had met Azusa. Even now, he thought his days were happy and fulfilling.

lines.japanese:
だがあずさは、一歩前に出たがっているようだ。
　不満があるのだろうか？
　今の関係では足りないのだろうか？
lines.english: But Azusa seemed eager to take another step. Was she dissatisfied? Was their relationship as it stood not enough?

lines.japanese: 考えてしまう忍だった。
lines.english: Shinobu could not help wondering.

lines.japanese:
友情の成立に至るまで、命掛けでドラマティック
な出来事を無数に通過してきたとは言わない。
lines.english: It wasn't as though they had braved countless dramatic, life-or-death ordeals before becoming friends.

lines.japanese:
理由がなければ仲良くできない。
　友情にアリバイを求めるような真似は卑しいと思う。
lines.english: As though people needed a reason to be friends. Demanding an alibi for friendship struck him as sordid.

lines.japanese:
何がなくとも一緒にいて楽しいなら、友達になっ
ても良いと思う。
lines.english: If being together was fun even when nothing happened, surely that was reason enough to be friends.

lines.japanese: いや―――
lines.english: No—

lines.japanese:
それこそがもっとも尊い気持ちなのではないか？
　あずさと忍はどうだろう。
　忍と彼らとはではどうだろう。
lines.english: Wasn't that the most precious feeling of all? What did it mean for Azusa and Shinobu? What did it mean for Shinobu and the others?

lines.japanese:
そして思考の迷宮に立ち入ることが、すでにして
アリバイ探しだ。
lines.english: Yet entering this maze of thought was itself a search for an alibi.

lines.japanese: 「むぅ」
lines.english: “Mmph.”

lines.japanese:
自分でも気付く。
　頬を叩いた。
lines.english: He caught himself. Then slapped his cheeks.

lines.japanese:
実際、あの壮絶な冷戦状態からはじまった関係は、
いくつかの事件を経てその距離を縮めてしまった。
lines.english: In truth, a relationship born of that brutal cold war had drawn closer through a handful of incidents.

lines.japanese:
一言で表せば、助けてしまったのだ。
　だからあずさにとって忍は助け手だ。
lines.english: In a word, he'd gone and helped her. And so, to Azusa, Shinobu was the one who had helped.

lines.japanese:
基礎情報。外せない項目。
　割り切ってしまうのが一番健全であろう。
lines.english: A basic fact. An indispensable entry. The healthiest course was simply to accept it.

lines.japanese:
あずさが自分に懐く理由は、単に相性が良いとい
うだけではなく、別個に存在するのである。仕方な
いことに。
lines.english: Azusa's attachment to him rested on more than simple compatibility; there was another reason for it altogether, and there was no getting around that.

lines.japanese:
当時、忍は友人を作る方法について悩んでいた。
　そのことをあずさに相談したこともある。
　対して彼女が提示したのは、同盟の申し出だった。
lines.english: Back then, Shinobu had been worrying over how to make friends. He had even asked Azusa for advice. Her answer had been an offer of alliance.

lines.japanese:
他人→友達。
　あの前後、忍が味わった持続する緊張は、名状し
がたいものだった。
lines.english: Strangers → friends. The unrelenting tension Shinobu endured around that time had been beyond description.

lines.japanese:
友達→Ｘ
　何が代入されるとしても、また重苦しい日々を味
わう可能性、大。
lines.english: Friends → X. Whatever value went into X, the odds were high that another stretch of oppressive days would follow.

lines.japanese: 「帰ろう……」

lines.japanese: いそいそと身支度を整え、工場をあとにした。

lines.japanese: さて―――
lines.english: And then—

lines.japanese: 真打ち登場と顔に書いてある。
lines.english: Her face all but announced: the star has arrived.

lines.japanese:
気まずくて隠れていたわけではなく、完全にスパ
イ目的であったのか、無表情の中にもそこはかとな
く満足げな色。
lines.english: She had not been hiding out of embarrassment. Apparently, espionage had been her sole objective: beneath the blank expression lay the faintest gleam of satisfaction.

lines.japanese:
携帯を取り出し、アンテナを確認。
　短縮ダイヤルから電話をかける。
lines.english: She took out her cell phone and checked the antenna. Then placed a call from speed dial.

lines.japanese: 「もしもし？　兄？」
lines.english: “Hello? Brother?”

lines.japanese: 「愛妹です」
lines.english: “It's your darling little sister.”

lines.japanese: 「あるいは媚妹Ｂａ―――」
lines.english: “Or perhaps your shamelessly adoring little si—”

lines.japanese: 「……ちっ、切られた」
lines.english: “…Tch. He hung up on me.”

lines.japanese: 再度かけなおす。
lines.english: She called again.

lines.japanese: 「もしもし？」
lines.english: “Hello?”

lines.japanese:
「あずささん、忍さんをデートに誘うつも。
　次の日曜日。告白練習みたいなことしてた。
　で、当の忍さんが―――」
lines.english: “Azusa plans to ask Shinobu on a date. Next Sunday. She was practicing something like a confession. And Shinobu himself—”

lines.japanese:
葉子は。
　鈍いが、鋭い。
　さらに別の相手に電話をかける。
lines.english: Youko was— slow, yet sharp. She placed another call to someone else.

lines.japanese: 「もしもし、ひょうきんユミです」
lines.english: “Hello, this is Yumi the Comedienne.”

lines.japanese: 「切らないでやめて」
lines.english: “Don't hang up! Wait!”

lines.japanese: 「実はですね笛子さん―――」
lines.english: “The thing is, Fueko—”

lines.japanese: 何の問題もなく、話は筒抜けになっていく。
lines.english: Without the slightest difficulty, word was getting out.

lines.japanese: 「だから、おまえには積極性が足りないんだ」
lines.english: “That's your problem. You're not assertive enough.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなこと言ったってぇ……」
