lines.english: The walk continued.

lines.japanese:
といっても見慣れた風景には違いない。
　目新しさはない。
　ただ光っていた。
lines.english: It was still the same familiar landscape. There was nothing new about it. It simply shone.

lines.japanese:
世界が煌めいていた。
　脳内の分泌がもたらす、錯覚の一種だろう。
　視界に写るすべてが希望に満ちている。
lines.english: The world glittered. Perhaps it was simply an illusion produced by chemicals in his brain. Everything he saw brimmed with hope.

lines.japanese:
不安が薄れていく。
　のんびりと、このまま眠ってしまってもいいと思
えるほどに。
lines.english: His anxiety faded. He grew so calm he thought he might happily drift off just as he was.

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、おぼえてる？」
lines.english: “Hey, do you remember?”

lines.japanese: 「去年も、こうやって二人で歩いたよね」
lines.english: “We walked like this together last year, remember?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだっけ」
lines.english: “Did we?”

lines.japanese:
「みんなと一緒するようになって、二人で遊ぶこと
　なくなっちゃったから、よく覚えてるよ」
lines.english: “Once we started hanging out with everyone, the two of us stopped doing anything alone. That's why I remember it so well.”

lines.japanese: 「だからかな。いつでも来られる場所なのにね」
lines.english: “Maybe that's why. I can come here anytime, and yet…”

lines.japanese: 「―――すごく、好きなの。このあたりを歩くの」
lines.english: “—I really love walking around here.”

lines.japanese: 「そう」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 「あずさの大切な場所にお邪魔しちゃってるのか」
lines.english: “So I'm intruding on a place that's special to you?”

lines.japanese: 「違うよ。いつもは一人でぶらついてるけど……」
lines.english: “No. I usually wander around here by myself, but…”

lines.japanese: 「本当は忍君と歩きたい場所だったんだ」
lines.english: “The truth is, this is where I wanted to walk with you.”

lines.japanese:
忍はあずさの語りを、ぼんやりと聞いている。
　頭痛はない。
　ふらつくが、痛みに呻くことはない。
lines.english: Shinobu listened to Azusa talk through a haze. His head no longer hurt. He still wobbled, but at least he was no longer groaning in pain.

lines.japanese: 穏やかである。
lines.english: It was peaceful.

lines.japanese:
散歩という体裁をとってはいるが、あずさは忍の
一挙一動に目を光らせているのがわかった。
lines.english: They called it a walk, but he could tell Azusa was watching his every move.

lines.japanese:
衰弱した忍が転ばないよう。
　怪我をしないよう。
　小さなからだで、懸命に守ろうとしていた。
lines.english: To keep the weakened Shinobu from falling. To keep him from getting hurt. Small as she was, she was doing everything she could to protect him.

lines.japanese:
伝わる気持ちが忍には嬉しい。
　純粋な好意の波。
lines.english: He could feel it, and it made him happy. A wave of pure affection.

lines.japanese:
デートや言葉や贈り物などに包装されていない、
バルク商品めいた感情。
lines.english: Affection in bulk, with no wrapping of a date, words, or gifts.

lines.japanese:
大切なのは中身であると知ってはいても、表層を
気にするものだ。
lines.english: Even when you knew the contents were what mattered, it was human nature to care about the wrapping.

lines.japanese:
あずさは包まれていない。
　包む術を知らない。
　だから純度だけが高い。
lines.english: Azusa came unwrapped. She had no idea how to wrap herself. That only made her feelings purer.

lines.japanese: 忍にとって包み方なんてものはどうでも良い。
lines.english: Shinobu did not care how they were wrapped.

lines.japanese:
世界がおだやかだから、あずさが楽しげに見える
から。
lines.english: Because the world was gentle, because Azusa looked happy—

lines.japanese: だから笑えるのである。
lines.english: he could smile.

lines.japanese:
「あ、そーそー。あの小川、メダカが戻ってきたん
　だよ」
lines.english: “Oh, right! The ricefish are back in that stream.”
“…Ricefish?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。タニシとかがいたせいかな」
lines.english: “Uh-huh. Maybe because there were pond snails.”

lines.japanese: 「そういえば、前はむちゃくちゃ群れてたね……」
lines.english: “Come to think of it, there used to be swarms of them…”

lines.japanese: 「あれ気持ち悪かったねー……」
lines.english: “That was pretty gross…”

lines.japanese: 苦笑する。
lines.english: She gave a wry smile.

lines.japanese: 「なんか知らないけど、今は普通の数になってる」
lines.english: “No idea why, but their numbers are normal now.”

lines.japanese: 「そう」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 「見よう」
lines.english: “Let's go look.”

lines.japanese: 忍を河原に連れて行く。
lines.english: She led Shinobu down to the riverbank.

lines.japanese:
かつては工業用水を廃棄されていたかも知れない
流れだ。
lines.english: The stream might once have been used to dump industrial wastewater.

lines.japanese:
今はもう、汚染の痕跡は見られない。
　陽光を受けて輝く水面の奥、生物群が漂っていた。
lines.english: There was no longer any visible trace of pollution. Beneath the sunlit sparkle of the surface, living things drifted through the water.

lines.japanese: 「タガメは……まだいないか」
lines.english: “No giant water bugs yet, I guess…”

lines.japanese:
それはさすがに。
　顔に出たに違いない。
lines.english: Now that was asking a lot. The thought must have shown on his face.

lines.japanese:
「う……こんなこと言ってるから、お子様扱いされ
　たんだね、章二のやつに」
lines.english: “Ugh… I guess saying stuff like that is why Shouji treated me like a little kid.”

lines.japanese: 「章二はあずさを、対等の相手として見てたよ」
lines.english: “Shouji saw you as an equal.”

lines.japanese: 「うそぉ」
lines.english: “No way.”

lines.japanese: 「本当」
lines.english: “It's true.”

lines.japanese:
「あずさと話してるときの章二って、あれで悪くな
　い気分のはずだから」
lines.english: “Whatever it looks like, Shouji must enjoy talking to you.”

lines.japanese: 「しんじがたいにゃー」
lines.english: “I find that purr-etty hard to believe.”

lines.japanese:
「対等だから、けっこう本気で怒るよ。
　今度試してみるといいよ」
lines.english: “He gets genuinely angry because he sees you as an equal. Try it next time and see.”

lines.japanese: 「……うん、そうする」
lines.english: “…Okay. I will.”

lines.japanese: 屈託なく、あずさは頷いた。
lines.english: Azusa nodded without a care.

lines.japanese: 「水、だいぶ澄んできてる」
lines.english: “The water's gotten a lot clearer.”

lines.japanese: 「あーあー、そんなのぞきこんだら落ちるよ」
lines.english: “Hey, hey! If you lean over like that, you'll fall in!”
“Ah…”

lines.japanese:
視野がかしいだ。
　垂直に大地に押しつけられていた体が、引力に委
ねられてしまう。
lines.english: His field of vision tipped. His body, which the earth had held upright, surrendered to gravity.

lines.japanese: 「わあっ！」
lines.english: “Wah!”

lines.japanese: 繋いだ手を引き綱に、あずさが踏みとどまる。
lines.english: Azusa planted her feet, their joined hands a tether.

lines.japanese: 「むくくく～～～っっっ」
lines.english: “Nnnnngh—!”

lines.japanese: 根性による十秒。
lines.english: Ten seconds of pure grit.

lines.japanese:
地球対あずさの闘いは拮抗し、やがて趨勢はゆっ
くりと少女の側に傾いた。
lines.english: Earth and Azusa fought to a standstill, until the balance slowly tipped in the girl's favor.

lines.japanese: 忍は再び霊長類としての立場を取り戻す。
lines.english: Shinobu regained his place among the primates.

lines.japanese: 「……ぜはー、ぜはー」
lines.english: “…Huff… huff…”

lines.japanese: 「ごめん」
lines.english: “Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「みなみの」
lines.english: “Minamino.”

lines.japanese: 「キレイだね」
lines.english: “It's beautiful.”

lines.japanese: 「でしょお？」
lines.english: “Isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「あずさも、きれいだ」
lines.english: “You're beautiful too, Azusa.”
“…Beautiful?”

lines.japanese: 「みんなきれいだ」
lines.english: “Everything is beautiful.”
“Sh-Shinobu…”

lines.japanese:
照れ。無邪気な笑顔。一瞬よぎる憂い。そしてま
た笑み。
lines.english: Embarrassment. An innocent smile. A momentary shadow. Then a smile again.

lines.japanese: 表情の移ろい。
lines.english: Her expressions came and went.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あははははっ、いやだなー、突然」
lines.english: “Ah—ahahaha! Don't spring that on me!”

lines.japanese:
「……キレイだなんて言われたのははじめてです、
　あたし」
lines.english: “…No one's ever called me beautiful before. Not once.”

lines.japanese: 「キレイだよ、ちゃんと」
lines.english: “But you are. Truly.”

lines.japanese: 「うぐっ……」
lines.english: “Guh…”

lines.japanese: 熟れたリンゴと化した。
lines.english: She turned into a ripe apple.

lines.japanese: 「……まいりました」
lines.english: “…You win.”

lines.japanese: 少し縮んだ気がした。
lines.english: She seemed to shrink a little.

lines.japanese: 「何かあった？」
lines.english: “Is something wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「どう、して？」
lines.english: “How… did you know?”

lines.japanese: 「そんな気がしたから」
lines.english: “I had a feeling.”

lines.japanese:
再び表情ルーレット。
　最後には。
lines.english: Her face became a roulette wheel again. It finally stopped on—
“…Oh. Sorry…”
Tears—

lines.japanese: 「悲しいの？　それとも痛い？」
lines.english: “Are you sad? Or are you hurting?”

lines.japanese: 「両方」
lines.english: “Both.”

lines.japanese: 「……大変だ」
lines.english: “…That's rough.”

lines.japanese: 「どうしてわかっちゃうんだろう……」
lines.english: “How can you tell…?”

lines.japanese: 「年の差だけは永遠に変わらないから」
lines.english: “Because the age gap is the one thing that will never change.”

lines.japanese:
「だから、あずさの本音はいつまでもわかると
　思うよ」
lines.english: “That's why I think I'll always know how you really feel.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは……そんなこと、言ったね、あたし……」
lines.english: “Ahaha… I did say that, didn't I…?”

lines.japanese:
こつ、額を胸板に預けてくる。
　そのときばかりは、忍もしっかと大地に立った。
lines.english: With a soft bump, she rested her forehead against his chest. For that moment, Shinobu stood firm upon the earth.

lines.japanese: 「今日ね、お母さんの命日」
lines.english: “Today's the anniversary of my mother's death.”
“…What…?”

lines.japanese: 「一周忌なんだ」
lines.english: “It's the first anniversary.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだったのか……」
lines.english: “I had no idea…”

lines.japanese: 「お墓参りには？」
lines.english: “Have you visited her grave?”

lines.japanese: 「行ってない、行くつもりなかった」
lines.english: “No. I wasn't planning to.”

lines.japanese: 「行っても、あの人は喜ばないと思ったから……」
lines.english: “I didn't think she'd be happy if I went…”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことないよ」
lines.english: “That's not true.”

lines.japanese: 「でも」
lines.english: “But…”

lines.japanese: 「お母さんは、あずさのことが好きだったよ」
lines.english: “Your mother loved you, Azusa.”

lines.japanese: 「それだけは間違いないと思う」
lines.english: “That much I'm sure of.”

lines.japanese: 「ただ……接し方がわからなかっただけ」
lines.english: “She just… didn't know how to treat you.”

lines.japanese: 肩に手を置く。
lines.english: He put a hand on her shoulder.

lines.japanese:
薄い少年めいた体格の芯に、華奢な骨格が感じら
れる。
lines.english: Beneath that slight, boyish frame, he could feel the delicacy of her bones.

lines.japanese:
本当に細い。
　以前より痩せた気もする。
lines.english: She was so thin. Maybe thinner than before.

lines.japanese: 「行かなくちゃ」
lines.english: “You have to go.”
“…But…”

lines.japanese:
「お母さんにも、僕らみたいな仲間がいれば良かっ
　たんだよ、きっと」
lines.english: “I’m sure it would have been better if your mother had had friends like us, too.”

lines.japanese: 「運が悪かったね」
lines.english: “She was unlucky.”
“Shi… nobu…!”

lines.japanese: 腕の中、肩が不規則に上下する。
lines.english: In his arms, her shoulders rose and fell in ragged spasms.

lines.japanese: 「声、殺さないでいいよ」
lines.english: “You don't have to choke it back.”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、あぁぁぁぁ―――」
lines.english: “Wah… aaaaaah—”

lines.japanese: 裏返った泣き声が、可聴域を超えて透明になる。
lines.english: Her cry cracked, climbed beyond the range of hearing, and turned transparent.

lines.japanese:
空に吸い込まれた。
　だがそれはごく短い間だけの出来事だ。
lines.english: The sky swallowed it. But only for a moment.

lines.japanese: 「―――ぁああああぁぁぁっ！！」
lines.english: “—Aaaaaaaaaaah!!”

lines.japanese: 戻ってきたあずさを、胸元に頭を抱く。
lines.english: When Azusa returned to him, he cradled her head against his chest.

lines.japanese:
痛いくらいに抱きしめても平気だと忍は思う。
　その痛さが、きっとあずさを楽にするとも考える。
lines.english: He thought he could hold her so tightly it hurt. He thought that pain might ease hers.

lines.japanese: 「あぁああぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁーーーーーー」
lines.english: “Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah—”

lines.japanese:
咳と嗚咽を織り交ぜながら。
　小さな子供のようにあずさは声を張り上げた。
lines.english: Between coughs and sobs, Azusa wailed like a little child.

lines.japanese: 薄い世界で、聞いているのは忍だけだ。
lines.english: In that thin world, only Shinobu heard her.

lines.japanese:
忍は幸せだった。
　だが周囲の人間がそうとは限らない。
lines.english: Shinobu was happy. That did not mean the people around him were.

lines.japanese:
川にメダカが戻った。
　だが全てが戻るとは限らない。
lines.english: The ricefish had returned to the river. That did not mean everything would return.

lines.japanese:
忍のぼやけた心を、錆びた刃が貫いた。苦痛。
　なぜだか無性に、あずさに申し訳ない気がした。
lines.english: A rusted blade pierced Shinobu’s hazy heart. Pain. For some reason, he felt an overwhelming sense of guilt toward Azusa.

lines.japanese: 「……ずっと、一緒にいよう」
lines.english: “…Let's stay together forever.”

lines.japanese: 「……っ、ひくっ……んっ……」
lines.english: “…Hhk… hic… mm…”

lines.japanese: 「それくらいしかしてあげられないから」
lines.english: “It's about the only thing I can do for you.”

lines.japanese:
あずさが自分のことを好いてくれるのなら、慰め
にはなるはずだ、と。
lines.english: If Azusa cared for him, he thought, then that at least should bring her some comfort.

lines.japanese: 口には出さず、考えた。
lines.english: He thought it, but did not say it aloud.

lines.japanese: 「あとで、二人でお墓参りに行こう―――」
lines.english: “Later, let's visit her grave together—”

lines.japanese: あずさと歩むことを、報告しようと思った。
lines.english: He meant to tell her mother that he and Azusa would walk on together.

lines.japanese: 「次はこっち」
lines.english: “This way next.”

lines.japanese:
面差しに明度を取り戻したあずさの、目尻はまだ
少し赤い。
lines.english: There was light in Azusa's face again, though the corners of her eyes were still a little red.

lines.japanese: 二人は散歩の続き。
lines.english: They resumed their walk.

lines.japanese: 「いいスポットがあってね」
lines.english: “I know a great spot.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ」
lines.english: “Oh?”

lines.japanese: 「きっと気に入ると思うよ」
lines.english: “I'm sure you'll like it.”

lines.japanese: あずさは忍を、森に誘う。
lines.english: Azusa beckoned Shinobu toward the forest.

lines.japanese: 「もしかして、森の主？」
lines.english: “Could it be the lord of the forest?”
“The what?”

lines.japanese: 「真ん中にある大きな樹」
lines.english: “That huge tree in the middle.”

lines.japanese: 「あちゃ……」
lines.english: “Aw, shoot…”

lines.japanese: 片手で目を覆った。
lines.english: She covered her eyes with one hand.

lines.japanese: 「あやあ」
lines.english: “Oh dear.”

lines.japanese: 「うわー……知ってたんだ」
lines.english: “Oh no… You knew about it already.”

lines.japanese:
「沙也加が好きな場所、なんだよね……
　そこって……」
lines.english: “That’s a place Sayaka likes, isn’t it…? That spot…”

lines.japanese: 「よりにもよってサヤちゃん……かあ……」
lines.english: “Of all people, Saya… Oh, man…”

lines.japanese: ダメージは大きいようだった。
lines.english: That seemed to hit hard.

lines.japanese:
「その……なんといっていいのかわかんないけど、
　ご愁傷様……」
lines.english: “I… don't really know what to say, but… my condolences.”

lines.japanese: 「ひぎん……」
lines.english: “Hngh…”

lines.japanese: 「分が悪い……かなあ……沙也加ちん相手だと……」
lines.english: “I don't have much of a chance… against Sayaka… do I?”

lines.japanese: 「えーとー……」
lines.english: “Ummm…”

lines.japanese: 答えにくいのは確かだ。
lines.english: It was certainly a hard question to answer.
“…Am I no good?”

lines.japanese:
上目遣いに問いかけてくる。
　忍は問いかけて欲しくなかった。
lines.english: She asked, looking up at him. Shinobu wished she wouldn't.

lines.japanese: 「だめってことはない。全然ない」
lines.english: “It's not that you're no good. Not at all.”

lines.japanese: 「……それに、今は二人しかいないんだし」
lines.english: “…Besides, right now it's just the two of us.”

lines.japanese: 「そだね」
lines.english: “That's true.”

lines.japanese: にへら、とあずさ。
lines.english: Azusa broke into a goofy grin.

lines.japanese: 「みんなどこに行ったのやらね」
lines.english: “I wonder where everyone went.”

lines.japanese: 「さーねー」
lines.english: “Who knows?”

lines.japanese: 二人で空を見上げた。
lines.english: Together they looked up at the sky.

lines.japanese: 迷いのない青天井。
lines.english: A blue vault without a trace of doubt.

lines.japanese: 「行こう」
lines.english: “Let's go.”

lines.japanese: 「けっこう歩くよ？　平気？」
lines.english: “We've got a fair way to go. Are you okay?”

lines.japanese: 「あたしはへーき」
lines.english: “I'm fine.”

lines.japanese:
「それになるべく運動してもらって、忍君にも丈夫
　になってもらわないといけないしね」
lines.english: “Besides, you need all the exercise you can get so you can get nice and strong.”

lines.japanese: 「うわあ」
lines.english: “Oh, boy.”

lines.japanese:
これ以上丈夫になるのはいろいろ難しい気もした
が、何も言わないでおいた。
lines.english: For various reasons, he doubted he could get any sturdier than he already was, but he kept quiet.

lines.japanese:
二人はのんびりと森に向かう。
　樹冠をいただく深い場所に。
lines.english: They strolled toward the forest, toward its deep, green-crowned reaches.

lines.japanese: 「ずっと……こうやって手繋いでたいな」
lines.english: “I wish… we could keep holding hands like this forever.”

lines.japanese: 「限界への挑戦だね」
lines.english: “Now that's a test of endurance.”

lines.japanese: 森へ―――
lines.english: Into the forest—

lines.japanese:
そこは忍にとって、安心できる世界だ。
　安心が口を軽くする。
lines.english: It was a world where Shinobu felt safe. Feeling safe loosened his tongue.

lines.japanese: 「ねえ……告白していい？」
lines.english: “Hey… can I confess something?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、あらたまってなに？」
lines.english: “What's with the formality all of a sudden?”

lines.japanese: 「ずっと手を繋いだままは難しいけど、」
lines.english: “Holding hands forever would be hard, but—”

lines.japanese:
「僕たち、気持ちでは繋がってるんだ。
　ずっと前から」
lines.english: “we're connected at heart. We have been for a long time.”

lines.japanese: 「本当だよ」
lines.english: “It's true.”

lines.japanese: 「……それって、丈夫？」
lines.english: “…Is it sturdy?”

lines.japanese: 「すごく」
lines.english: “Very.”

lines.japanese: 「ずっと切れない？」
lines.english: “It'll never break?”

lines.japanese: 「とても無理だね」
lines.english: “Not a chance.”

lines.japanese: 「すごいこと聞いちゃった気がする」
lines.english: “I feel like you just told me something incredible.”

lines.japanese: 「最高機密だよ」
lines.english: “It's top secret.”

lines.japanese: 「……ありがと」
lines.english: “…Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 「忍君のこと好きになって良かったよ、あたし」
lines.english: “I'm glad I fell in love with you, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: あずさが言葉にしたのは、はじめてかも知れない。
lines.english: It might have been the first time Azusa had ever put it into words.

lines.japanese: 「ずっと一緒にいようね」
lines.english: “Let's stay together forever.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 森に―――
lines.english: Into the forest—

lines.japanese:
「じゃあ……一緒にいてくれるなら、あたし忍くん
　のこと守ってあげるね」
lines.english: “Then… if you'll stay with me, I'll protect you, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「何から？」
lines.english: “From what?”

lines.japanese: 「いろいろなものから」
lines.english: “All kinds of things.”

lines.japanese:
「その前に、強くならないといけないけど……
　あははは」
lines.english: “I'll have to get stronger first, though… Ahahaha.”

lines.japanese: 「……頼りにしてるよ」
lines.english: “…I'm counting on you.”

lines.japanese: 「行こう」
lines.english: “Let's go.”

lines.japanese: 森へ―――
lines.english: Into the forest—

lines.japanese:
木々の合間にできた自然の道のり。
　二人は草を踏んで進んでいく。
lines.english: A natural path wound between the trees. The two of them pressed onward through the grass.

lines.japanese:
迷いなく暗闇に向かう少女の背が、少し違ったも
のに見えた。
lines.english: From behind, the girl walking unhesitatingly into the darkness looked somehow different.

lines.japanese: （あずさ……妖精みたいだな）
lines.english: (Azusa… looks like a fairy.)

lines.japanese: （……案外、本当にそうなのかも）
lines.english: (…Maybe she really is one.)

lines.japanese: （だとしても……構わないけどね―――）
lines.english: (Even if she is… that's fine with me—)

lines.japanese: 深く、深く。
lines.english: Deeper and deeper.

lines.japanese:
人間社会から切り離された領域。
　静穏の園。
lines.english: A realm cut off from human society. A garden of tranquility.

lines.japanese: 悲しみも、嘆きも、労苦もない。
lines.english: No sorrow. No lamentation. No toil.

lines.japanese:
二人はまるで一つになったかのように、かたく結
びついたまま、奥まった世界へと進んでいく。
lines.english: Still clasped tight, as though they had become one, the two of them moved deeper into that hidden world.

lines.japanese:
忍たちの姿はやがて陽光から遮断され、
　緑が濃くなってできた闇に、
lines.english: Soon Shinobu and Azusa passed beyond the reach of sunlight, into darkness made by the deepening green—

lines.japanese: 融けていったのである―――
lines.english: where they melted away.

lines.japanese: 503 Service Unavailable
lines.english: 503 Service Unavailable

lines.japanese: 気がつくと、工場にいる。
lines.english: When he came to, he found himself in the factory.

lines.japanese: 自分だけだ。誰もいない。
lines.english: He was alone. No one else was there.

lines.japanese:
屋内に詰められた空気が、重く不安を押し込めて
くる。
lines.english: The air trapped indoors weighed on him, packing him full of dread.

lines.japanese: 一人では広すぎる空間を、ことさら持てあます。
lines.english: The space was too vast for one person; alone, he felt all the more at a loss.

lines.japanese:
耳がツンとする。
　頭痛がひどい。
　苦痛の波が、等間隔で訪れる。
lines.english: Pressure stung his ears. His head was splitting. The pain came in waves at regular intervals.

lines.japanese: 「痛いよ……沙也加……」
lines.english: “It hurts… Sayaka…”

lines.japanese:
愛おしい名を、呼んだ。
　忍は立ち上がる。
lines.english: He called the name of someone he loved. Shinobu got to his feet.

lines.japanese:
足が地面に触れるだけで、脳天に杭を打たれたよ
うだ。
lines.english: Each footfall was a spike driven into the crown of his head.

lines.japanese: だが停止しているより、動きたい。
lines.english: Still, he would rather move than stay still.

lines.japanese: 「誰か……いないの？」
lines.english: “Is anybody… there?”

lines.japanese: 工場内に気配はない。
lines.english: There was no sign of anyone in the factory.

lines.japanese: 「ねえ」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.japanese:
隙間を調べてみる。
　無論、誰もいるわけがない。
lines.english: He peered into the gaps. Of course no one was there.

lines.japanese: 「……あずさ」
lines.english: “…Azusa.”

lines.japanese: それは半身の名。
lines.english: The name of his other half.

lines.japanese: 人気がない。
lines.english: No one around.

lines.japanese:
郊外のせいなのか、もっと致命的な原因によるも
のか、判断できない。
lines.english: He could not tell whether that was because he was out in the suburbs, or because of some more catastrophic cause.

lines.japanese: 彷徨うしかない。
lines.english: All he could do was wander.

lines.japanese:
とても止まってはいられないからだ。
　止まれば、狂う。
lines.english: He could not bear to stop. If he stopped, he would lose his mind.

lines.japanese:
葉子の姿もない。
　彼女は待っていない。
lines.english: Youko was nowhere to be seen either. She was not waiting.
“Youko…”

lines.japanese: 守りたかった者の名だった。
lines.english: It was the name of the person he had wanted to protect.
“Itsuki…”

lines.japanese:
忠実だった少年の名もまた、過去のものとなって
しまったのか。
lines.english: Had the name of that loyal boy also become a thing of the past?

lines.japanese:
街に向かう。
　誰を捜しているのかさえ、自覚できないまま。
lines.english: He headed for town. He did not even know whom he was searching for.

lines.japanese: 街。
lines.english: Town.

lines.japanese: どうしたことか、誰もいない。
lines.english: For some reason, no one was there.

lines.japanese:
とたんに、抜けるような青空が疎ましい。
　仕切りがないことがたまらなく煩わしい。
lines.english: The boundless blue sky suddenly repulsed him. Its lack of walls was unbearably oppressive.

lines.japanese:
一人もいないなどということがありえるのか？
　実際に人影もなく、雑踏は死んでいる。
lines.english: Was it possible for not a single person to be here? Yet not a soul moved. The bustle of the streets lay dead.

lines.japanese: ……殺されている。
lines.english: …Murdered.
“Fueko…”

lines.japanese:
潔白であろうとした少女は、追想にしか姿を見せ
ない。
lines.english: The girl who had tried to remain blameless now appeared only in his memories.

lines.japanese:
何時間も、忍は歩く。
　だがどこに行っても、人影はない。
lines.english: Shinobu walked for hours. But wherever he went, he found no one.

lines.japanese:
一人別世界に迷い込んだように、広くてとりとめ
のない世界だ。
lines.english: The world sprawled wide and shapeless, as though he alone had strayed into some other plane.

lines.japanese:
夕刻。
　だが自宅には戻りたくない。
lines.english: Evening. He still did not want to go home.

lines.japanese:
工場に戻ってしまう。
　それでも忍にとって、自宅に戻るよりはましだった。
lines.english: He ended up back at the factory. Even so, it was better than going home.

lines.japanese:
残滓が感じられるから。
　今となっては、駅前のひといきれさえ懐かしい。
lines.english: Because he could still sense the remnants there. By now, even the human crush outside the station seemed dear to him.

lines.japanese:
ソファに身を横たえる。
　空き腹なのに、食欲はない。
lines.english: He lay down on the sofa. He was hungry, but had no appetite.

lines.japanese:
気力が尽きていた。
　シーツに包まれる。
lines.english: All strength of will had left him. He wrapped himself in a sheet.
“Shouji…”

lines.japanese: 友の名が、こぼれた。
lines.english: His friend's name fell from his lips.

lines.japanese: 翌朝。
lines.english: The next morning.

lines.japanese: 耐え難い空腹で目が覚める。
lines.english: Unbearable hunger woke him.

lines.japanese:
ぐっすり寝て、気力も少しは回復していた。
　乾燥野菜のスープを作る。
lines.english: A sound sleep had restored a little of his strength. He made soup with dried vegetables.

lines.japanese:
軽い吐き気でなかなか飲み込めなかったが、胃袋
が慣れるにつれ食欲が出た。
lines.english: At first, mild nausea made it hard to swallow, but as his stomach adjusted, his appetite returned.

lines.japanese: いつだかに誰かが焼いたクッキーを囓る。
lines.english: He nibbled at cookies someone had baked—who knew when.

lines.japanese:
食後、少し横になる。
　頭痛は……まだ続いている。
lines.english: After eating, he lay down for a while. The headache… lingered.
“Hot…”

lines.japanese:
熱がある。
　昨日、動いたせいだろうか。
　身体を泥のように重くする、厄介な熱だ。
lines.english: A fever. Was it from yesterday's exertion? A troublesome fever, making his body heavy as mud.

lines.japanese:
人はなく、身は喘ぐ。
　あとどれほど生きることができるのかと、忍は考
える。
lines.english: No one was there, and his body labored for breath. Shinobu wondered how much longer he could live.

lines.japanese: その途端、猛烈な生への渇望が満ちていた。
lines.english: In that instant, a fierce hunger for life flooded him.

lines.japanese: 「死にたくない……」
lines.english: “I don't want to die…”

lines.japanese:
下半身の高ぶりを意識する。
　気怠く、苦悶にあるというのに、なお肉体は求め
るのだ。
lines.english: He became aware of the arousal in his lower body. Languid and racked with pain, his flesh still yearned.

lines.japanese: 「ううっ」
lines.english: “Ngh…”

lines.japanese:
生きたい。
　死にたくはない。
lines.english: He wanted to live. He did not want to die.

lines.japanese: だがふとしたはずみで、心に忍び込んでくる。
lines.english: Yet at the slightest opening, something crept into his heart:

lines.japanese: もがき苦しみながら生きることへの、冷たい疲弊が。
lines.english: a cold exhaustion at living on through pain and struggle.

lines.japanese:
楽になりたい。
　だが生きたい。
　なぜ生きるんだろう。
lines.english: He wanted release. But he wanted to live. Why go on living?

lines.japanese: なにを目的として？
lines.english: Toward what end?

lines.japanese:
見捨てられた者の感情が、忍を襲う。
　仲間だった者たちはいない。
　いなくなった。
lines.english: The feelings of the abandoned swept over Shinobu. Those who had been his companions were gone. Gone away.

lines.japanese:
どこに行ったのかはわからない。
　他人になった。
lines.english: He did not know where they had gone. They had become strangers.

lines.japanese:
十年生きれば、どこかで再会することもあり得る
だろう。
lines.english: If he lived another ten years, perhaps he might run into one of them again somewhere.

lines.japanese:
だけど……そのとき二人は笑いかわすことができ
るのか？
lines.english: But… when that happened, would the two of them still be able to smile at one another?

lines.japanese:
苦い記憶と化した思い出が、胸を刺したりはしな
いのか？
lines.english: Would memories turned bitter pierce them through the heart?

lines.japanese:
無言ですれ違うことになったりはしないか？
　別離とはそういうことだ。
lines.english: Would they pass each other in silence? That was what parting meant.

lines.japanese:
変わりゆく友を見守ることもできず、結果だけを
突きつけられる。
lines.english: You could not watch your friend change. All you saw was the result, thrust before you.

lines.japanese: 時としてそれは、苦しみの生だ。
lines.english: Sometimes, that made life a torment.
“Mm…”

lines.japanese:
浅い眠りから、意識を引きはがす。
　工場にいることが、ひどくつらく思えてきた。
lines.english: He dragged his consciousness out of a shallow sleep. Being in the factory had begun to feel unbearably painful.

lines.japanese:
千鳥に会いたい。
　不器用にでもいい、とにかく話したい。
lines.english: He wanted to see Chidori. However awkwardly, he simply wanted to talk to her.

lines.japanese:
立ち上がり、歩き出す。
　いつだって人は、そうするしかないのだから。
lines.english: He got up and started walking. It was all anyone could ever do.

lines.japanese: 自宅に向かう。
lines.english: He headed home.

lines.japanese:
だが我が家、という印象はあまりない。
　寄る辺ない身を、一時置いていただけの場所だった。
lines.english: It did not feel much like home. Only a place where his rootless self had stayed for a while.

lines.japanese: 一歩近づくごとに、不安も膨れていく。
lines.english: His unease swelled with every step nearer.

lines.japanese: 「ただい、ま」
lines.english: “I'm… home.”

lines.japanese: 玄関をまたぐ。
lines.english: He crossed the threshold.
“…Sis?”

lines.japanese:
返事がない。
　空気が冷たい。
　ずっと人を包んでいない、室内の空気だ。
lines.english: No answer. The air was cold. The air of a room that had held no one in a long time.

lines.japanese: 「いないの？」
lines.english: “You're not here?”

lines.japanese: 千鳥はいない。
lines.english: Chidori was not there.

lines.japanese:
頭痛がしつこい。
　常備してある薬を服用する。
　念のため、自室に。
lines.english: The headache would not relent. He took some of the medicine they kept on hand. To be safe, he went to his room.

lines.japanese:
時刻を確認したかった。
　壁の時計を見ると、午前１０時で止まっていた。
lines.english: He wanted to check the time. The clock on the wall had stopped at ten in the morning.

lines.japanese:
気力が萎える。
　時間のことはどうでもよくなった。
lines.english: His will failed him. He no longer cared what time it was.

lines.japanese:
もしかすると、自分は世界から見捨てられてしま
ったのではないか？
lines.english: Could it be that he had been abandoned by the world itself?

lines.japanese:
忍はそんな馬鹿げたことを考えた。
　友のない人生に、価値を見いだせるほど独立した
人間ではない。
lines.english: Such an absurd thought crossed Shinobu's mind. He was not independent enough to find meaning in a life without friends.

lines.japanese:
己が己であるために何かを成すには……忍の自我
は未成熟だ。
lines.english: To do something that would let him remain himself… his sense of self was still immature.

lines.japanese:
無意識か、導かれてか。
　中庭に出た。
　お茶会をするという約束だった。
lines.english: Whether unconsciously or by some guiding hand, he went out into the courtyard. They had promised to hold a tea party.

lines.japanese:
その日のために、忍は道具を買いそろえ、芝生を
整え、花を植えた。
lines.english: Shinobu had bought the supplies, tended the lawn, and planted flowers all for that day.

lines.japanese: 「無駄になった……んだよね」
lines.english: “It was all for nothing… wasn't it?”

lines.japanese: その虚しさを認めるのがつらい。
lines.english: Admitting the futility of it hurt.

lines.japanese:
目を覆う。
　涙が、
lines.english: He covered his eyes. Tears—

lines.japanese: 「無駄じゃない」
lines.english: “It wasn't for nothing.”

lines.japanese: 忍は弾かれたように顔を上げた。
lines.english: Shinobu's head snapped up.

lines.japanese: 「無駄なんかじゃ、ない」
lines.english: “It wasn't all for nothing.”

lines.japanese:
微笑む少女の姿を、忍は見る。
　知らない顔立ち。
lines.english: Shinobu saw a girl smiling. An unfamiliar face.
“Who… are you?”

lines.japanese:
長い沈黙を経由して、問いかける。
　そして少女は答えた。
lines.english: After a long silence, he asked the question. Then the girl answered.

lines.japanese: いたわるよう。
lines.english: As if to soothe him.

lines.japanese: 慰めるよう。
lines.english: As if to console him.

lines.japanese: 愛するよう。
lines.english: As if to love him.

lines.japanese: 「イマ」
lines.english: “Ima.”

lines.japanese: 打ち明けるよう―――
lines.english: As if sharing a secret—

lines.japanese:
家の前まで来て、忍は立ち止まる。
　そして考える。
lines.english: Shinobu reached the house and stopped outside. And thought.

lines.japanese:
扉を開けて、ただいまと告げて、もし誰もいなか
ったら。
lines.english: If he opened the door, called “I'm home,” and found no one there—

lines.japanese:
あたたかな声が返ってこなかったら。
　果たして自分は、それに耐えられるのかどうか。
lines.english: If no warm voice answered— could he bear it?

lines.japanese: 「……姉さん」
lines.english: “…Sis.”

lines.japanese:
不在の義姉。
　だが本当に、ただの不在なのか？
lines.english: His absent sister. But was it really nothing more than absence?

lines.japanese:
今の忍は、そんな疑惑を解消することさえできな
い、暗愚な少年でしかない。
lines.english: As he was now, Shinobu was merely a foolish boy, unable even to put that suspicion to rest.

lines.japanese: 気がつけば、忍は工場のふところに佇立していた。
lines.english: When he came to, Shinobu stood in the factory's embrace.

lines.japanese: （逃げたんだ……僕は）
lines.english: (I ran away…)

lines.japanese: 両手を見る。
lines.english: He looked at his hands.

lines.japanese: （逃げたから……誰も、いない）
lines.english: (Because I ran away… there's no one here.)

lines.japanese: （いなくなってしまった……）
lines.english: (They're all gone…)

lines.japanese: （みんながどうなったかも知らないで……）
lines.english: (I don't even know what happened to them…)

lines.japanese:
呻く。
　声を絞り出す。
lines.english: A groan. He wrung out his voice.

lines.japanese: 「うあ、ああああああっ！」
lines.english: “Uah… aaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 慟哭の反響。
lines.english: The echo of a wail.

lines.japanese:
一つの罪が与える苦痛が、一つだけとは限らない。
　実証するかのように、残響は忍を斬りつけた。
lines.english: The pain a single sin inflicted did not have to come only once. As if to prove it, the echoes slashed at Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「見届けることもできずに！」
lines.english: “I couldn't even see it through to the end!”

lines.japanese: 椅子を蹴り飛ばす。
lines.english: He kicked a chair across the room.

lines.japanese:
振動が頭に伝わって、割れそうな痛みを長く残余
させる。
lines.english: The shock traveled into his head, leaving a splitting ache that would not fade.

lines.japanese:
だが憤りは苦痛さえ打ち消し、新たな怒りへ連鎖
させた。
lines.english: But fury blotted out even the pain and set off another wave of anger.

lines.japanese:
「だって！　だって、そうしなけりゃ、みんなを……
　みんなが……あいつらが！！」
lines.english: “But! But if I hadn't, everyone… They… those bastards!!”

lines.japanese:
本棚を殴りつける。
　棚以上に、拳と頭が軋んだ。
lines.english: He struck a bookcase. His fist and his skull creaked worse than the shelves.

lines.japanese: 「その結果が……これなのか……」
lines.english: “And this… is what came of it…?”

lines.japanese:
そのまま拳を添え滑らせ、頽れる。
　膝で地面を叩くように。
lines.english: Keeping his fist pressed to it, he slid to the floor and crumpled, landing hard on his knees.

lines.japanese: 「なんだ……この結末は……」
lines.english: “What… kind of ending is this…?”

lines.japanese: あとは嗚咽だけの忍だ。
lines.english: After that, Shinobu was all sobs.

lines.japanese: 「ううう、うううううう……」
lines.english: “Uuuh… uuuuuugh…”

lines.japanese: 「うああああ、あ、あああああああ」
lines.english: “Uaaaaah… ah… aaaaaaaah…”

lines.japanese:
それは無垢な怒り。
　陰気に覆われた心を照らす、圧倒的な赤の曙光。
lines.english: It was pure rage. An overwhelming red dawn illuminating a heart shrouded in gloom.

lines.japanese: そして、
lines.english: And then—

lines.japanese: （僕は）
一片の疑問。
lines.english: A single shard of doubt.

lines.japanese: （……何に対して、腹を立てているんだ？）
lines.english: (…What am I angry at?)

lines.japanese:
たわんだ体が、ぴくと震える。
　疑問は忍を瞬時に満たした。
lines.english: His bowed body twitched. The question flooded Shinobu in an instant.

lines.japanese: （殺した、そう殺した）
lines.english: (I killed them. Yes, I killed them.)

lines.japanese:
（でも殺したこと自体、誰かに強制されたこと
　なのか？）
lines.english: (But had anyone forced me to kill them?)

lines.japanese: 違う。
lines.english: No.
“No…”

lines.japanese: 断じてそんなことはない。
lines.english: Absolutely not.

lines.japanese: 「断じて、そんなことはない」
lines.english: “Absolutely not.”

lines.japanese: 戦慄に襲われ、忍は瞬きさえ忘れる。
lines.english: A shudder seized Shinobu. He forgot even to blink.

lines.japanese:
（違う、違うぞ？
　なんだ、どうして違和感なんだ？）
lines.english: (No. No—that's wrong. What is this? Why does something feel wrong?)

lines.japanese: 顔を持ち上げる。
lines.english: He raised his head.

lines.japanese: 「ここよ、忍」
lines.english: “I'm here, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 少女が、いた。
lines.english: The girl was there.

lines.japanese:
忍は目を閉じる。
　乾いた瞳に、痺れにも似た苦痛。
lines.english: Shinobu closed his eyes. His dry eyes hurt, with a sensation almost like numbness.

lines.japanese: 再び目を開いても、なお少女の姿は在った。
lines.english: When he opened them again, the girl was still there.

lines.japanese: 「ここにいるの、忍」
lines.english: “I'm right here, Shinobu.”
(Who… is she?)

lines.japanese: 「ここに来て」
lines.english: “Come here.”

lines.japanese:
「あなたが納得するまで同じ日々を繰り返したなら、
　きっと辿り着ける」
lines.english: “If you repeat the same days until you can accept them, I'm sure you'll find your way here.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、待ってる」
lines.english: “So I'll be waiting.”

lines.japanese: 「わたしが消えてしまう前に」
lines.english: “Before I disappear.”

lines.japanese: 「迷宮の先で―――」
lines.english: “Beyond the labyrinth—”

lines.japanese: 気がつけばまた、工場のふところに佇立していた。
lines.english: When he came to, he once again stood in the factory's embrace.

lines.japanese: あずさの気配。
lines.english: Azusa's presence.

lines.japanese:
振り返れば、立っていたのは紛れもなく紅緒あず
さだ。
lines.english: He turned. Standing there, unmistakably, was Azusa Benio herself.

lines.japanese:
ひどく疲れていた。
　動く力が失われていた。
　まるで一昼夜歩き続けたような疲労感。
lines.english: He was utterly exhausted. He had no strength left to move. It felt as though he had walked without stopping for a full day and night.

lines.japanese:
声も出ない。
　呼びかける気力が出なかった。
lines.english: He could not even speak. He could not muster the will to call out to her.

lines.japanese: あずさは、じっと見つめ返してきた。
lines.english: Azusa gazed steadily back at him.

lines.japanese:
夕日を背負っている。
　輪郭が目映さに霞む。
　忍は今何をすべきかを見失う。
lines.english: The setting sun was at her back. Her outline blurred in its radiance. Shinobu no longer knew what he ought to do.

lines.japanese:
目の前にいるあずさの唇が、妙に気になった。
　まさかとは思う。
lines.english: He found himself strangely preoccupied with Azusa’s lips. Surely not, he thought.

lines.japanese: だがもしかすると、あり得ることなのかも知れない。
lines.english: And yet, perhaps it was possible.

lines.japanese:
どんな可能性だって信じられ、いかなる将来も辿
り着くまでは不確かな絵空事だった。
lines.english: Any possibility seemed believable, and every future was only an uncertain fancy until he reached it.

lines.japanese:
近しいものを感じる。
　触れたくなる。
lines.english: He felt close to her. He wanted to touch her.

lines.japanese:
忍にとってあずさとは、肉親でもあり友でもあり
家族でもあり……あるいは―――
lines.english: To Shinobu, Azusa was kin, friend, family… and perhaps—

lines.japanese: （あるいは―――）
lines.english: (And perhaps—)

lines.japanese:
原因が思い出せない。
　忍の記憶が、行為が、愛着を沈殿させたのか。
lines.english: He could not remember what had caused it. Had Shinobu's memories and actions left this affection to settle within him?

lines.japanese: （あずさとは、確か……ん……わからないな）
lines.english: (Azusa and I… I’m sure… Mm… I don’t know.)

lines.japanese: （でも）
lines.english: (But…)

lines.japanese: （理由なんていらない気がする）
lines.english: (I don't think I need a reason.)

lines.japanese: （考えなくても良い気が、する―――）
lines.english: (Maybe I don't have to think about it—)

lines.japanese:
思考を切り替える。
　せめてできること。
　微笑を作った。
lines.english: He changed tack. At least there was one thing he could do. He made himself smile.

lines.japanese:
この行為にもすっかり慣れた。
　かけがえのないあずさに向けた。
　少女は緋色を背に、うっすらと紅咲いた。
lines.english: He had grown thoroughly accustomed to the act. He offered the smile to Azusa, who was irreplaceable to him. Against the scarlet sky, a faint blush bloomed on the girl's face.

lines.japanese:
夕日以上に印象的で、慈しみがあって、あずさが
老成してしまったかのような錯覚さえ抱く。
lines.english: It was more striking than the sunset, so full of tenderness that he could almost imagine Azusa had grown wise beyond her years.

lines.japanese: 「やあ」
lines.english: “Hi.”

lines.japanese: やっとのことで、声を出した。
lines.english: At last, he managed to speak.

lines.japanese: （他人の声みたいだ―――）
lines.english: (It sounds like someone else's voice—)

lines.japanese: あずさは私服を着ていた。
lines.english: Azusa was dressed in casual clothes.

lines.japanese: 「おかえり」
lines.english: “Welcome home.”

lines.japanese: 「……ただいま」
lines.english: “…I'm home.”

lines.japanese:
笑みは自然と保たれる。
　気が楽になる。
lines.english: The smile stayed without effort. His heart grew lighter.

lines.japanese:
工場では、先客があとから来た方をもてなすこと
になっている。
lines.english: At the factory, whoever arrived first played host to whoever came after.

lines.japanese: そうたいしたことではない。
lines.english: Nothing elaborate.

lines.japanese:
お茶を淹れたり、お菓子があれば出したり、その
程度。
lines.english: Brewing tea, setting out whatever snacks were available—that sort of thing.

lines.japanese: （何をしようかな―――）
lines.english: (What should I do—?)

lines.japanese: 小さな幸せに、思いを馳せた。
lines.english: He let his thoughts linger on that small happiness.
